jobs.title: Risk & Trading Associate
jobs.excerpt: PENN Entertainment, Inc.  is North America’s leading provider of integrated entertainment, sports content, and casino gaming experiences.
jobs.description:
PENN Entertainment, Inc. is North America’s leading provider of integrated entertainment, sports content, and casino gaming experiences. From casinos and racetracks to online gaming, sports betting and entertainment content, we deliver the experiences people want, how and where they want them.

We’re always on the lookout for those who are passionate about creating and delivering cutting-edge online gaming and sports media products. Whether it’s through Hollywood Casino, theScore Bet Sportsbook, or theScore media app, we’re excited to push the boundaries of what’s possible. These state-of-the-art platforms are powered by proprietary in-house technology, a key component of PENN’s omnichannel gaming and entertainment strategy.

When you join PENN Entertainment’s digital team, you’ll not only work on these cutting-edge platforms through theScore and PENN Interactive, but you’ll also be part of a company that truly cares about your career growth. We’re committed to supporting you as you expand your skills and explore new opportunities.

With locations throughout North America, you can build a future at PENN Entertainment wherever you are. If you want to challenge conventions in gaming, media and entertainment, we want to talk to you.

About the Role & Team

The Risk and Trading Team is responsible for all Sports Betting products, prices, risk management, Boosts, Specials, Promotions and Player Props in a fast-paced, 24/7 North American facing operator. You will be part of the team looking after the above duties as the global Sports calendar requires. We are currently looking for highly motivated and suitably qualified team players. This role requires a highly professional, organized, and enthusiastic individual who is data driven, is obsessed by sports and sports betting and willing to push the boundaries to continuously improve the product.

This role is not for narrow risk management, this role is for taking risk management on the full 360 of the Sportsbook product, performance, promotion, presentation, and pricing. If you want to put the fan and the fan experience at the centre of the Sportsbook read on.

About the Work

  • Learn the basics of bet ticker monitoring
  • Have the ability to quickly carry out price comparisons
  • Add accurate and informative bet notes
  • Obtain familiarity with internal & external Trading tools
  • Understand the interaction between Vegas & 3rd-party provider consoles and identify where to take action as needed (price cut, market suspension or removal)
  • Assist Traders with grading, customer support queries, notifications & manual market creation
  • Monitor liabilities, promos, and anomalies in real time
  • Tag suspicious activity and escalate bonus abuse or sharp players
  • Assist with exposure dashboards and reporting tasks
  • Learn player profiling and basic risk segmentation

About You

  • Post-secondary degree in a relevant field, such as mathematics, business or other fields within analytical disciplines
  • Must be able to work weekends, evenings and holidays
  • 1 to 2 years’ experience in a trading environment or assessing and calculating risk within the areas of insurance or finance advantageous
  • Good all round sports betting knowledge and a strong interest in betting and odds required
  • Data obsessed, not just data driven. Excellent mathematical skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving ability
  • Flexibility is a must as working hours will be dictated by business needs. Must be able to work flexible schedules including nights, weekends, and public holidays
  • Able to multitask and work under pressure
  • Ability to work in fast paced environment and make decisions quickly
  • Must have exceptional time management skills
  • High attention to detail and precision in delivery
  • Ability to learn quickly, work independently and in a team setting
  • Strong initiative and outstanding work ethic

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Comprehensive Benefits package
  • Fun, relaxed work environment
  • Education and conference reimbursements
Salary Range
$48,000—$55,000 USD

Penn Interactive is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.Base pay is one part of the Total Rewards that Penn Interactive provides to compensate and recognize employees for their work. Most sales positions are eligible for a Commission under the terms of an applicable plan, while most non-sales positions are eligible for a Bonus. Additionally, Penn Interactive provides best-in-class benefits to eligible employees. We believe that benefits should connect you to the support you need when it matters most, and should help you care for those who matter most. That’s why we provide an array of options, expert guidance and always-on tools, that are personalized to meet the needs of your reality – to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life.

jobs.title: People Manager (Asia Based) for non-profit energy think tank
jobs.excerpt: Own the people function of a global think tank accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified energy system.
jobs.description:
Own the people function of a global think tank accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified energy system.

The role

This is a senior, hands-on People Manager role within a mission driven, global organisation. We're looking for an experienced, autonomous HR practitioner who can operate confidently from day one - someone ready to lead the day-to-day running of Ember's people function, shape how HR works in practice, and be the senior HR voice managers across the organisation turn to.

You’ll lead the day-to-day running of Ember’s people function - shaping how HR works in practice, operating within the direction and governance set by our Head of Operations.

After several years of rapid growth, the focus is now on maintaining high-quality, consistent and well-judged people practice across regions, and supporting managers and staff to navigate people matters with confidence and care.

You’ll set clear standards for HR practice, provide experienced judgement on complex or sensitive issues, and ensure our people processes are fair, compliant and aligned with Ember’s values. You won’t do everything yourself: you’ll empower the People Officer to lead delivery across core people processes, providing oversight rather than day-to-day intervention in agreed operational areas, and building capability within the People team through coaching, feedback and guidance.

With your background in Asian HR, you’ll bring valuable insight to ensure Ember’s policies and practices work well across different regions, strengthening our ability to manage people matters confidently across the globe and keeping our approach fair, consistent, and connected.

We’re looking for someone who is confident in using AI and digital tools to streamline, automate and improve HR processes, from people data and reporting to learning, policy management and employee support. You’ll be excited to work in an organisation that actively embraces innovation and the thoughtful use of AI to work more effectively, freeing up time to focus on people, impact and continuous improvement.

About Ember

Ember is an independent, not-for-profit energy think tank that aims to accelerate the clean energy transition with data and policy. We gather, curate and analyse data on the power sector and coal mine methane emissions, and use our findings to improve energy and climate policy.

See our work at and

Key responsibilities

Leadership and Line Management

  • Provide direct line management to the People Officer, supporting their professional growth, ensuring workloads are achievable, and setting clear objectives.
  • Provide coaching and guidance to build capability in handling HR cases, employee relations, and systems.
  • Ensure the People team delivers consistently high-quality support to Ember staff worldwide.

HR Operations & Employee Relations

  • Oversee delivery of employee lifecycle processes through the People Officer,, ensuring processes (recruitment, onboarding, performance management, learning and development, and offboarding) run smoothly and consistently across global locations.
  • Lead the use of digital and AI-enabled tools to streamline, automate and improve HR processes, data management and reporting, freeing up capacity for higher-value people work while ensuring ethical, transparent and values-aligned use of AI.
  • Hold responsibility for employee relations outcomes, acting as a trusted advisor to managers across Ember and providing senior HR judgement on people issues such as disciplinary and grievance cases, performance management, absence and wellbeing, and policy interpretation. This involves constructively challenging decisions, pushing back on poor practice, and holding the line on fairness and compliance even when it's uncomfortable. The People Officer will lead routine employee relations cases, with the People Manager providing coaching, guidance and escalation support on more complex or sensitive matters, ensuring outcomes are fair, consistent, legally compliant and aligned with Ember’s values.
  • You'll make sound decisions on complex and sensitive cases, keeping senior leadership informed on higher-stakes matters - bringing them your proposed approach and recommendation for action.
  • Proactively develop systems, tools, and guidance that equip managers to manage people matters confidently and consistently. This includes building their capability to handle sensitive issues and supporting them to reach outcomes that are fair, and sustainable.

Policy, Compliance & Global HR Expertise

  • Monitor external HR and employment law developments (particularly across Asia), providing practical recommendations to keep Ember ahead of emerging risks and opportunities.
  • Own Ember’s HR policy framework, ensuring policies are practical, user-friendly, reflect best practice and are legally compliant across Ember’s regions, while being applied consistently in practice.
  • Delegate policy drafting, maintenance and day-to-day implementation to the People Officer, providing review, sign-off and guidance as needed.
  • Provide clear, accessible advice on HR and employment issues, with strong expertise in Asia and familiarity with global contexts.
  • Oversee relationships with Employer of Record providers and other HR/benefits partners.
  • Ensure HR data and records are accurate, secure, and meet data protection requirements.
  • Support the exploration of digital and AI-driven tools to improve efficiency, accuracy, and inclusivity across HR processes, while ensuring alignment with Ember’s values.

Organisational Development & Culture

  • Work with the People Officer and managers to embed Ember’s values across teams, particularly in remote and cross-cultural contexts
  • Provide leadership and guidance on employee engagement, wellbeing and retention initiatives
  • Work with managers to strengthen learning and development opportunities, career pathways, and succession planning.
  • Support managers to build positive team cultures aligned with Ember’s values, with a focus on inclusion, equity, and diversity.
  • Use HR data and feedback to identify trends and recommend changes that improve the employee experience.

Strategic HR Contribution

  • Work closely with the Operations Manager and COO to set Ember’s People priorities for the coming years, providing advice and insights based on evidence and HR best practice.
  • Identify opportunities to make People processes, systems, and structures simpler, fairer, and more effective.
  • Support organisational design and workforce planning, helping Ember build the skills and capacity needed to achieve its mission.
  • Provide HR insights and analysis to senior management by collecting and interpreting HR metrics (e.g. turnover, engagement, absence, diversity), using them to identify risks and opportunities.

Requirements

Must have

  • A recognised mid-level HR qualification or equivalent professional experience. Examples include CIPD Level 5, SHRM-CP, PHR, IHRP-CP, CPHR, HKIHRM membership, or a relevant HR degree, combined with a demonstrable track record of operating at a senior, strategic level - shaping people strategy and policy, not only delivering it.
  • Deep, applied knowledge of employment law and HR practice across Asian jurisdictions, with a track record of advising on complex, ambiguous or novel situations where the answer isn't in the policy
  • Experience operating as the most senior or sole HR practitioner in an organisation, region or business unit - comfortable being the person others escalate to, with no HR safety net above you.
  • Experience of using AI-enabled digital tools to improve, automate or streamline HR processes with an understanding of opportunities and risks.
  • A track record of managing complex employee relations cases end to end, including disciplinary, grievance, absence management, and performance concerns.
  • Demonstrable experience developing and implementing HR policies and procedures.
  • Proven track record of line management and development of HR professionals.
  • Ability to analyse HR metrics, identify trends, and make recommendations to improve organisational effectiveness.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills, with ability to build trust at all levels.
  • High emotional intelligence, resilience, and ability to handle sensitive matters with confidentiality and integrity.
  • Strong organisational and project management skills.

Nice to have

  • An advanced or post-graduate HR qualification (e.g. CIPD Level 7, SHRM-SCP, SPHR) or Charted membership of a recognised HR body.
  • Experience working in a remote-first, international, or non-profit organisation.
  • Familiarity with payroll, benefits, and employment practices across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Experience leading on L&D strategy or career development frameworks.
  • Working knowledge of HRIS and data-driven HR practices.
  • Experience of using or implementing AI-driven or digital HR systems, with an understanding of opportunities and risks.

We are an equal opportunities employer committed to diversity and treating all employees with dignity and respect regardless of background.

Benefits

Salary: £41, 576 - £49,892 per year, dependent on experience and on local cost-of-living. Salaries may be adjusted upwards for candidates living in high cost locations in Asia (such as Singapore, South Korea); specific ranges will be shared with interview invitations.

Contract: Full time (but only working 9 days every fortnight with no reduction in pay), permanent subject to a 3 month probationary period. For employees based outside of the UK, a local payroll contract is available, dependent on the country.

Remote culture and diverse team: Ember is a remote-first organisation, with talents of diverse backgrounds from 20+ countries over the world.

Further benefits: We offer a competitive benefits package, including:

  • We operate a nine-day fortnight meaning our full-time staff are given every other Friday off work with no reduction in pay
  • 25 days holiday, plus UK bank holidays (unless local statutory minimums are higher) and for each year that you're part of the team at Ember you'll receive an additional day of holiday, up to a maximum of 5 additional days.
  • Generous paid maternity and paternity leave
  • Flexible working conditions, including the opportunity for part-time work and home working.
  • Access to a local working space can also be arranged for employees
  • Free annual eye tests
  • Access to a counselling service
  • Funding and allocated time for your training and development
  • Paid volunteer day
  • Four paid days off to enable low carbon travel
  • Time off to donate blood

Full-Stack AI Engineer

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours
Location: Remote (LATAM, Eastern Europe, Pakistan, India, South Africa Preferred)

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Full-Stack AI Engineer to build, deploy, and scale AI-powered applications that solve real business problems.

This role combines full-stack software engineering with applied AI/ML expertise. You’ll work across AI pipelines, backend systems, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and modern frontend frameworks to deliver scalable, production-ready AI applications. You’ll collaborate closely with engineering, product, and data teams to build intelligent automation, chat experiences, analytics tools, and AI-powered workflows.

Responsibilities

AI & LLM Development

  • Integrate AI/ML models using OpenAI, Hugging Face, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar frameworks.
  • Build AI inference APIs using FastAPI, Flask, Node.js, or similar technologies.
  • Develop RAG pipelines using vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, or FAISS.
  • Implement embeddings, semantic search, and AI-powered workflows.
  • Optimize inference performance, scalability, and cost.

Full-Stack Development

  • Build frontend applications using React, Next.js, Vue, or similar frameworks.
  • Develop backend services and APIs connecting AI models with business logic.
  • Build AI-powered features including chatbots, copilots, dashboards, and automation tools.
  • Design secure, scalable, and maintainable application architectures.

Data & Infrastructure

  • Build ETL pipelines and data workflows using Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, or similar tools.
  • Manage structured and unstructured datasets.
  • Deploy AI services using Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Build CI/CD pipelines and monitor system performance, reliability, and costs.

Security & Collaboration

  • Implement secure authentication, authorization, and API protection.
  • Maintain compliance with security and privacy standards where applicable.
  • Collaborate with engineering, product, and data teams to deliver production-ready AI solutions.
  • Document technical designs, workflows, and architecture decisions.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 3+ years of software engineering experience with AI/ML exposure.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Experience with AI/ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
  • Experience deploying machine learning or LLM solutions into production.
  • Strong frontend experience with React, Next.js, Vue, or similar frameworks.
  • Experience building APIs, backend services, and SQL-based data solutions.
  • Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud platforms.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building AI-powered SaaS or automation products.
  • Experience with RAG, embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search.
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, Vertex AI, or SageMaker.
  • Experience with microservices, serverless architectures, or distributed systems.
  • Experience optimizing AI inference performance and infrastructure costs.

What Success Looks Like

  • AI-powered features delivered on schedule.
  • Reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient production systems.
  • Strong application uptime and inference performance.
  • Increased automation through AI-powered workflows.
  • Clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.

Interview Process

  • Initial Recruiter Screening
  • Technical Assessment
  • Client Interview
  • Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. It’s a short, self-recorded video that completes your application and allows hiring managers to get to know you before the interview process begins.

Rather than repeating your background during multiple screening calls, you’ll tell your story once, allowing future interviews to focus on meaningful conversations.

Don’t overthink it—you can record as many takes as you’d like before submitting. Your invitation will come from Spark Hire, so please check both your inbox and spam folder.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - k6 Core | Sweden | Remote
jobs.excerpt: Grafana Labs, the company behind the open observability cloud, is founded on the principles of open source, open standards, open ecosystems, and open culture.
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs, the company behind the open observability cloud, is founded on the principles of open source, open standards, open ecosystems, and open culture. Grafana Cloud, our fully managed observability platform, is flexible and built for scale. With Grafana Cloud's actually useful AI, organizations can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data to move at the speed of their ambitions. Today, more than 35 million users and 7,000+ customers – including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce – trust Grafana Labs to ensure reliability of their applications and systems, resolve incidents quickly, and optimize their telemetry to reduce noise and cost. We are a 100% remote company with 1,600+ team members across 40+ countries, and we’re backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

Senior Software Engineer - k6 Core

The Opportunity:

At k6, we build reliability and performance testing tools for developers and QA engineers.

Grafana k6 is an open-source project focused on making performance testing practical, approachable, and useful in real-world engineering workflows. We care deeply about developer experience, correctness, and scalability. k6 is part of the Grafana ecosystem and is used by engineers to test and understand systems under real load.

What You’ll Be Doing:

You will join a team of engineers responsible for building and maintaining k6, a performance testing tool written in Go. The team also maintains the open-source project, which means working directly on the product, the codebase, and with the community using it.

In this role, you will work on features and improvements across the k6 codebase, from initial idea through implementation and delivery. Much of the work involves problems that are not fully specified up front and require understanding the context, evaluating trade-offs, and choosing a reasonable technical approach.

You will work with a high degree of independence while collaborating closely with other engineers on design, implementation, and code reviews. You are expected to deliver production-quality code, maintain existing functionality, and help keep the system reliable and maintainable over time.

Some work may involve the k6 cloud offering, which builds on top of k6 to run distributed tests across data centers worldwide. This includes Go services that support distributed execution and require careful attention to performance, correctness, and failure modes.

Because the team is small, your work will have a direct and visible impact on the product and its users. You will work alongside experienced engineers in an environment that values clarity, pragmatism, and sound engineering judgment.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

We start with problems, not prescriptions. Engineers are expected to understand the constraints, propose a pragmatic design, and carry the work through to delivery. We move deliberately and release on a regular cadence of roughly every six weeks. Between releases, we focus on small, safe, incremental changes.

Work is asynchronous by default, with decisions captured in pull requests and short design notes. Meetings are used for alignment rather than status updates. Code reviews focus on correctness, long-term maintainability, and user impact. When trade-offs are required, we aim to make them explicit and reversible. The team owns the product end to end, including architecture, releases, user-facing behavior, and the health of the open-source project.

We’re looking for an experienced engineer with strong programming skills and a track record of working on non-trivial systems.

You should have:

  • Strong experience building production software in Go, or another language with good support for concurrency and parallelism
  • Experience working on larger or long-lived codebases
  • The ability to work independently on scoped problems and deliver them to completion
  • Clear technical communication skills, especially in code reviews and design discussions
  • A good understanding of internet protocols such as HTTP, gRPC, and WebSockets, with some familiarity with lower-level networking concepts
  • Experience with modern development practices, including testing, code review, and iterative development

Bonus Points For:

You do not need experience with everything listed below. These are areas where familiarity is useful for the role, and the more you bring, the easier the ramp-up will be:

  • Contributing to or maintaining open-source projects
  • Prior experience using k6 in production, or contributing to the k6 project or ecosystem
  • Performance, reliability, or network testing and optimization
  • Distributed systems or cloud-based services
  • JavaScript and/or TypeScript
  • Backend systems for web or mobile applications
  • Tools and platforms such as Docker, AWS, microservices architectures, and observability tools like Grafana or APM systems

Compensation & Rewards:

In Sweden, the Base compensation range for this role is SEK 775,444- SEK 930,533. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.

jobs.title: Interconnection Specialist
jobs.excerpt: About Us and Why We’re HiringAt Terra Energy, we're committed to making clean energy more accessible by delivering high-quality residential solar solutions.
jobs.description:
About Us and Why We’re Hiring

At Terra Energy, we're committed to making clean energy more accessible by delivering high-quality residential solar solutions. As our business continues to grow, we're looking for an Interconnection Specialist to play a key role in ensuring our projects move efficiently through the utility approval process. This position is essential to keeping installations on track by coordinating interconnection applications, maintaining compliance, and collaborating with customers, utilities, and internal teams throughout the project lifecycle.

If you're highly organized, detail-oriented, and enjoy managing multiple priorities while working with cross-functional teams, we'd love to hear from you. This is an excellent opportunity to join a fast-paced, mission-driven company where your work will directly contribute to delivering renewable energy solutions and creating a seamless experience for our customers.

The Role

As an Interconnection Specialist, you will be responsible for managing the interconnection process for residential solar and energy storage projects from application submission through Permission to Operate (PTO). You'll work closely with utilities, customers, and internal teams to ensure all applications, documentation, and approvals are completed accurately, on time, and in compliance with utility and regulatory requirements.

In this role, you'll track project milestones, maintain organized and audit-ready records, coordinate customer documentation, resolve interconnection-related issues, and help identify opportunities to improve internal processes. Success in this position requires exceptional attention to detail, strong organizational and communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Manage the full interconnection lifecycle for residential solar and energy storage projects, from application submission through Permission to Operate (PTO).
  • Prepare, submit, and track interconnection applications with utilities, ensuring all requirements are met.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for utilities, responding to inquiries and following up on application status.
  • Coordinate directly with customers to obtain required documentation, signatures, and utility access for interconnection applications.
  • Maintain accurate, organized, and audit-ready records of all interconnection documents, agreements, and correspondence.
  • Monitor project timelines, identify potential delays or risks, and proactively escalate issues when necessary.
  • Collaborate with engineering, project management, permitting, and operations teams to keep projects moving efficiently.
  • Support the resolution of interconnection-related challenges, including utility requests, design updates, and technical clarifications.
  • Track interconnection approvals, milestones, and related documentation to ensure compliance with utility and regulatory requirements.
  • Contribute to process improvements by helping optimize workflows, documentation standards, and tracking systems.

What We’re Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience in solar operations, utility interconnection, project coordination, permitting, or a related role.
  • Experience working with utility companies, interconnection applications, or renewable energy projects is highly preferred.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally with customers, utilities, and internal stakeholders.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining accurate documentation and records.
  • Ability to identify issues, solve problems proactively, and escalate risks when appropriate.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment with changing priorities.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, Google Workspace, and project tracking or CRM systems.
  • Experience with solar industry platforms and utility portals is a plus.
  • High level of accountability, ownership, and commitment to delivering an outstanding customer experience.

Important to Know

  • This is a fully remote position, but you'll work closely with internal teams, utility representatives, and customers throughout the interconnection process.
  • Success in this role depends on staying organized, managing multiple projects simultaneously, and following up proactively to keep projects moving forward.
  • Strong attention to detail is essential, as you'll be responsible for maintaining accurate documentation and ensuring compliance with utility and regulatory requirements.
  • You'll be expected to communicate professionally with customers, utilities, and cross-functional teams while providing timely updates and resolving issues efficiently.
  • Experience in the residential solar industry or with utility interconnection processes is highly valued and will help you ramp up quickly.
  • This role offers the opportunity to make a direct impact on project success by helping customers achieve a smooth path to Permission to Operate (PTO) and supporting Terra Energy's mission to expand access to clean energy.

How You’ll Work at Terra Energy

At Terra Energy, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement are at the core of everything we do. As an Interconnection Specialist, you'll work cross-functionally with Operations, Engineering, Project Management, and Customer Support teams to keep projects moving efficiently from application submission through Permission to Operate (PTO). Your ability to communicate proactively, stay organized, and build strong relationships with utilities and customers will play a key role in our success.

We trust our team members to take ownership of their work, think proactively, and identify opportunities to improve processes. In this fully remote role, you'll have the autonomy to manage your workload while collaborating with a supportive team that values transparency, problem-solving, and delivering an exceptional customer experience. If you're passionate about renewable energy and thrive in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment, you'll fit right in.

Compensation & Details

  • Location:Remote
  • Reports to: Ops
  • Department: Operations
  • Salary: 45K Annually

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means keeping interconnection projects moving efficiently while ensuring every application, document, and customer interaction is handled accurately and on time. You'll consistently meet project milestones, maintain organized and compliant records, communicate proactively with utilities and customers, and help minimize delays by identifying and resolving issues before they impact project timelines.

You'll thrive by taking ownership of your work, collaborating effectively across teams, and contributing to continuous process improvements. A successful Interconnection Specialist is dependable, detail-oriented, and committed to delivering an exceptional customer experience while helping Terra Energy achieve its operational goals. Performance in this role is measured by timely completion of assigned work order milestones, with a target of 80% or higher.

In Summary

If you're a detail-oriented professional who enjoys coordinating projects, building relationships, and keeping complex processes on track, we'd love to meet you. As an Interconnection Specialist, you'll play a critical role in helping customers transition to clean energy by ensuring interconnection applications are completed accurately, efficiently, and in compliance with utility requirements.

Join Terra Energy and become part of a collaborative team that's driving the future of renewable energy. Here, your work will have a direct impact on project success, customer satisfaction, and our mission to make solar energy more accessible—one successful interconnection at a time.

Recruitment Process

  • Initial Contact (HR) – Quick intro and role overview
  • HR Interview – Experience and overall fit
  • Hiring Manager Interview – Technical and role deep dive
  • Offer Letter – Final offer and next steps

TrustLayer is a B2B insurtech SaaS platform that automates certificate of insurance (COI) verification and vendor compliance for businesses that manage risk across large vendor and subcontractor networks. We've grown to ~$8M ARR, serve roughly 1,000 customers, and process compliance for 400,000+ connected vendor parties. We're a lean, technical team, and we build fast.

The Role

We're looking for a Technical Marketing Coordinator who wants to learn growth marketing by actually doing it — building things, shipping them, and watching the numbers move. You'll work directly with our Marketing Manager and VP of Marketing to execute the campaigns, tools, and community programs that turn technical insight into pipeline.

This is an early-career role with an unusual amount of hands-on building. You won't be scheduling other people's meetings or formatting other people's decks. You'll be prototyping AI-powered lead magnets, keeping our practitioner community humming, and pulling the reports that tell us what's working. If you want to learn modern, AI-native marketing from the inside of a fast-moving team, this is that job.

What You'll Do

  • Build with AI tools. Help prototype and ship interactive tools, calculators, and content assets — using AI tooling (Claude, no-code/low-code builders) to move from idea to live asset fast. You'll build under direction at first; the goal is that within months you're shipping smaller assets end to end.
  • Own the day-to-day community. Run our community channels (Slack, LinkedIn, forums) as your turf: welcoming new members, seeding discussions, coordinating programming, and surfacing product feedback to the team. This is the one area where you own it outright from day one.
  • Support the content engine. Format, publish, and distribute content across blog, email, and social; maintain the editorial calendar; handle campaign execution in HubSpot (lists, emails, landing pages, workflows).
  • Learn the product and help translate it. Work with product and sales to turn technical capabilities (COI parsing, compliance automation, vendor risk scoring) into marketing assets that resonate with a technical, ROI-focused buyer — one-pagers, FAQ content, demo support materials. You'll draft with direction at first; the goal is that the translation increasingly becomes yours.
  • Pull the numbers. Maintain dashboards and pull weekly reports on funnel performance, engagement, and campaign results. You'll learn what the metrics mean and, over time, start spotting the stories in them yourself.
  • Coordinate events and partner campaigns. Handle logistics and asset preparation for industry events and co-marketing campaigns — speaker prep materials, campaign kits, follow-up sequences.
  • Run experiments. Execute the tests the team designs — new formats, channels, and AI-assisted workflows — and track results cleanly so we know what to kill and what to double down on.

What We're Looking For

  • 1–3 years of marketing experience (agency, in-house, internships, or serious side projects — show us what you've made)
  • Evidence that you build things: a portfolio, a newsletter, a community you grew, a tool you made with AI or no-code platforms — anything shipped beats everything theoretical
  • You love owning communities: you've built, grown, or moderated one (professional, hobby, Discord, subreddit — the venue matters less than the instinct) and you get genuine energy from keeping people engaged and coming back
  • Genuine curiosity about AI tools and a habit of trying them: you've already used ChatGPT or Claude to make something real, not just answer questions
  • Comfort with numbers: you can work in a spreadsheet without fear and want to get better at analytics
  • Strong writing fundamentals: clear, correct, and concise
  • Organized and reliable: you keep multiple workstreams moving and nothing falls through the cracks
  • Bonus: familiarity with HubSpot, SEO basics, or design/video tools

jobs.excerpt: About Better Impact Better Impact builds software for organizations that rely on people showing up for one another and their communities.
jobs.description:
About Better Impact

Better Impact builds software for organizations that rely on people showing up for one another and their communities.

Our platform helps nonprofits, hospitals, government agencies, volunteer centers, and corporate community programs recruit, onboard, schedule, train, communicate with, and understand the impact of their volunteers. More than 85,000 organizations across 20 countries use Better Impact today. In January 2026, Better Impact and Galaxy Digital combined to create a larger platform dedicated to volunteerism and community engagement.

We are now a team of more than 100 employees and FTEs, operating across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Australia. We are growing quickly, and our sales team is at the center of that growth.

This is a great moment for the right seller. The mission is strong. The market is large and still under penetrated. Our go-to-market motion is being rebuilt for scale. And there is real quota to win.

About the role

Better Impact is hiring an Account Executive to help carry our next phase of growth. This role will report directly to the VP of Sales.

This is a full-cycle, demo-driven closing role. You will run prospecting, discovery, demo, handle objections, negotiate, and close, primarily with volunteer program leaders at nonprofits, hospitals, government agencies, and volunteer centers.

The company has strong fundamentals: a large market, a proven demo-to-close motion, and leadership that is actively investing in the tools, training, and pricing structure that make it easier for you to win. We need AEs who can execute a proven process at volume today, and who want to grow with a team that is actively getting more disciplined, better resourced, and better enabled as it scales.

You will own your full pipeline: qualifying and running demos on inbound, SDR-sourced, and (increasingly) self-sourced leads, managing forecast and deal hygiene in HubSpot, and closing new business against a defined ACV and deal-volume target. You will work closely with your SDR or BDR team members, your VP of Sales, and Customer Success on handoff and onboarding.

What you will do

  • Run a full-cycle sales process from discovery through close: qualify inbound and SDR-set demos, lead a consultative, value-first demo, handle pricing conversations and objections, and close.
  • Build roughly 30% of your opportunity pipeline using outbound campaigns that incorporate calling, emailing and social (LinkedIn) strategies
  • Carry and hit a monthly quota built on ACV and closed-deal volume, with a clear weekly pipeline review and forecast cadence.
  • Build and protect a healthy pipeline, including a self-sourced component through outbound prospecting, sequence follow-up, and reengagement of past closed-lost opportunities.
  • Run demos and discovery from the volunteer's point of view first, not just the administrator's, using Better Impact's established demo methodology and closing checklist.
  • Use discovery to surface the prospect's own urgency rather than manufacturing it, and apply approved urgency and pricing frameworks consistently rather than improvising deal-by-deal.
  • Keep HubSpot pipeline data accurate and current: deal stage, next steps, decision maker and budget holder, and close date, so your forecast can be trusted.
  • Partner with your SDR/BDR and with Customer Success on clean handoffs, so new customers start onboarding with the right expectations and the right contacts.
  • Stay current on product, pricing, and competitive positioning as Better Impact modernizes its platform and pricing structure, and bring field feedback back to the team.

Requirements

What you bring

  • 2+ years of full-cycle, closing sales experience, ideally in SaaS or software, with a demonstrated track record of hitting or exceeding quota.
  • Experience building and running your own outbound sequences (Apollo, Sales Navigator, or similar) alongside inbound demo volume.
  • Comfort running a high-volume, demo-driven sales motion: this is a high-activity role with real deal velocity, not a long, low-volume enterprise cycle.
  • Strong discovery and objection-handling skills, with the ability to sell value and outcomes to a buyer who is not evaluating you on technology for its own sake.
  • Experience or genuine comfort selling to mission-driven, budget-conscious buyers (nonprofits, government, healthcare, education), including the ability to build urgency and justify price without becoming transactional.
  • Disciplined pipeline and CRM hygiene: accurate, current HubSpot data, reliable forecasting, and follow-through on next steps.
  • Coachability: a real track record of taking structured coaching (call reviews, scorecards, scripting) and visibly improving from it.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, comfortable presenting to both a single volunteer coordinator and, on larger deals, a broader buying committee.
  • Resilience and self-direction in a fast-changing environment: pricing, packaging, and process are actively evolving here, and you'll be expected to adapt quickly rather than wait for a finished playbook.

Strong pluses

These are not required, but they would help you ramp quickly:

  • Experience selling into nonprofits, volunteer programs, healthcare systems, higher education, or government/municipal buyers.
  • Experience with volunteer management, case management, CSR/ESG, or other mission-driven or compliance-adjacent SaaS categories.
  • Experience selling through a merger or major pricing/packaging change, and staying productive through that kind of transition.
  • Familiarity with HubSpot as a sales CRM.
  • Experience with a structured sales methodology (MEDDPICC, Sandler or similar) and comfort working from a defined closing checklist rather than an unstructured pitch.

Benefits

As part of our commitment to supporting you in both your professional and personal life, we offer a comprehensive range of employee benefit programs, including:

  • Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission
  • Medical, dental & vision insurance (after 90 days)
  • 401(k) program with an employer match (after 90 days)
  • Unlimited vacation + 9 paid holidays
  • Paid parental leave

  • Proven ability to successfully execute strategies in a matrixed organization

Preferred Qualifications

Title:

Sr. Manager, Subcontracts & Procurement

Belong, Connect, Grow, with KBR! - At KBR, we are passionate about our people and our Zero Harm culture. These inform all that we do and are at the heart of our commitment to, and ongoing journey toward being a People First company. That commitment is central to our team of team’s philosophy and fosters an environment where everyone can Belong, Connect and Grow. We Deliver – Together.

Program Summary

KBR's Exploration & Logistics (E&L) division is the Team Behind the Mission®. We deliver mission critical services to the U.S. military and coalition partners around the world. Our key capabilities include base operations; contingency and expeditionary support; next generation asset management; digitally focused logistics; prepositioned stock; and integrated supply chain management.

Job Summary

KBR is seeking a highly motivated Sr. Manager, Subcontracts & Procurement to oversee and perform a full range of procurement and subcontract administration/management activities associated with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) compliance across multiple contract types. This includes oversight of supplier qualification, issuing requests for proposals, evaluating proposals, and maintaining subcontract files in accordance with established procedures. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing subcontracting work on a project and ensuring the seamless integration of subcontract work within the broader program, including cost, schedule, technical, and quality management.

Under broad direction, the Sr. Procurement & Subcontracts Manager will be accountable for the performance and results of multiple related disciplines or sub-groups within the function, managing the delivery of functional objectives by providing leadership and direction to managers or professional staff. Additionally, the role involves participating in the development of functional strategy and may include responsibility for global processes and procedures.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Drive all aspects of major subcontract execution including cost, schedule, technical, and quality performance, ensuring full integration of subcontract work within the program (e.g., proposals, negotiations, contract execution).

  • Oversee the entire procurement cycle, coordinating between KBR’s technical team and suppliers across various functional teams, including Program Management, Small Business Liaison Officers, Finance & Accounting, IT Management, and Executive Management.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact between the subcontractor and project management team, remaining accountable to Supply Chain leadership.

  • Develop and sustain long-standing relationships with company-approved vendors (subcontractors).

  • Assist in developing subcontract specifications, work statements, and terms & conditions for specialized materials, equipment, and services.

  • Lead key supplier negotiations regarding cost, terms & conditions, and long-term agreements.

  • Provide oversight of price negotiations, quantity, and delivery schedules with critical suppliers.

  • Prepare subcontract documents in accordance with company policies and procedures assuring compliance with Government and Company requirements; Obtains appropriate approvals prior to issuance of Purchase Orders, Subcontract Agreements, and Service Agreements.

  • Review and administer subcontracts to ensure satisfactory progress and compliance with scope of work, as well as the terms and conditions of the subcontract. Role Summary

The front-office Quality Lead owns quality outcomes for the CRM, C&I, and Web teams — leading a small group of QA analysts and QE engineers day to day, while acting as the single point of contact for quality within those teams' sprint cycles, releases, and design conversations. This is a hands-on people-leadership role: part coach and career-manager for the team, part quality strategist for three product areas, and part operational owner for release quality on the teams covered. The role treats quality as a responsibility shared between QA and engineering, not something QA backstops alone — making that shared ownership real on each covered team, day to day, is core to the job. It reports to the Engineering Manager of Quality and is one of two Lead-level roles rebuilding the layer between individual QA/QE contributors and quality leadership (the other, on the Commodity Market Ops side, is filled by an internal promotion already in motion).

Key Responsibilities

  • People leadership — run a regular 1:1 cadence and THRIVE conversations with every QA analyst and QE engineer on the covered teams; hold a real career-development picture for each person (not everyone wants formal goals, and that's legitimate) and delegate in ways that grow people rather than just offload work; coach, set growth plans, and manage performance day to day; take an active role in interviewing as the team grows; escalate people issues to the EM of Quality when they exceed the Lead's authority to resolve.
  • Quality point of contact — be the go-to person for quality within CRM, C&I, and Web: attend sprint planning and story refinement, write or review acceptance criteria, and surface risk before it reaches UAT rather than after. Build visible signals — escaped-defect trends, coverage, recurring production issues — so quality health is evident before someone has to ask.
  • Sprint & functional test ownership — own who is doing what: assign and coordinate sprint testing and functional test coverage across the covered teams. This is currently an open gap org-wide (raised independently on the C&I side) and is one of the first things this role needs to close.
  • Release quality ownership — own the release-night quality gate rotation for front-office releases: staffing it, running the go/no-go call, and owning the escalation path when something's off.
  • Automation & tooling — maintain and grow the automation already in place across the covered teams (Playwright-based E2E, API/service-layer tests, Zephyr Scale for test case and cycle management); take ownership of in-flight tooling handoffs as they mature (e.g., release-notes automation, team-level test analysis tooling).
  • Cross-functional relationships — build real working relationships with the GPMs/PMs and engineering managers on each covered team, with a standing cadence (not just ad hoc) so priorities and risk move in both directions before they become surprises; be a partner in shaping what gets tested and when, not just an order-taker; represent quality's voice at the team level — and through the Quality Leads Sync — so it doesn't only show up at the steering level.
  • Reporting & follow-through — keep the EM of Quality informed on quality risk, throughput, and team health on a regular cadence, with no surprises; know what's this role's to resolve day to day (coaching, prioritization, technical direction) versus what to escalate (formal performance actions, compensation, staffing); use the relationship with the EM as a thinking partner on hard calls, and drive open issues to a real conclusion rather than a status update.

What Success Looks Like — First 90 Days

  • A 1:1 cadence is running with every QA analyst and QE engineer on CRM, C&I, and Web.
  • Sprint testing and functional-test ownership is explicit and understood on each covered team — no more “who's doing this?”.
  • The release-night rotation for front-office releases is staffed and running smoothly.
  • A working relationship is in place with each covered team's GPM/PM and engineering manager.
  • The EM of Quality has a clear, current read on team health and risk across all three teams.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Has led or mentored a QA/QE team before, ideally inside a matrixed org where reporting lines and product-team lines don't fully overlap.
  • Comfortable operating both hands-on (test design, automation, debugging a flaky pipeline) and as a people leader (coaching, growth conversations, performance management).
  • Leads with curiosity and humility — willing to dig personally into a flaky pipeline or a hard defect, quick to say “I don’t know yet” and pull in the right person, and clear on when to dig in versus when to delegate.

  • Ramps quickly on complex, regulated business domains; energy/utility experience is a plus but not required.
  • Fluent in modern QE practice — CI/CD pipelines, API/service-layer testing, shift-left habits — not a manual-regression-only background.

Location: Remote Timezone: NA/Eastern Type: Full-time Experience: 10+ Years

Role Overview

This position requires a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) specializing in Data, Machine Learning, and AI to embed directly within customer environments. You will serve as the primary technical authority transforming complex data challenges and operational bottlenecks into production-grade data pipelines, machine learning systems, and agentic AI solutions.

The role is heavily customer-facing: you will work alongside client business units and engineering teams to rapidly assess legacy data estates, build scalable modern data platforms, and deploy custom GenAI/LLM workflows that drive measurable business velocity. This is a high-ownership, hands-on role where you will leverage Spec-Driven Development (SDD) and AI-assisted workflows to build, refactor, and demonstrate immediate value directly where the customer operates.

Key Responsibilities

  • Customer Embedding & Data Delivery: Deploy directly into customer environments to understand their domain logic, underlying data pipelines, and architectural constraints. Own end-to-end delivery—from data discovery and schema design to pipeline deployment and model integration—building trust as the customer's lead technical partner.
  • Data Platform & Architectural Modernization: Partner with client business leaders to evaluate legacy technology estates (e.g., monolithic SQL databases, or unmaintained ETL jobs). Lead engineering efforts to refactor legacy data setups into modern lakehouses, event-driven streaming systems, and scalable vector/graph databases.
  • Spec-Driven Development (SDD) for Data & AI: Apply a "spec-first" engineering workflow using Generative AI tools. Write structured specifications (data models, API schemas, transformations, and evaluation metrics) that instruct AI agents to generate production data models, PySpark jobs, data pipelines, and test suites.
  • Agentic AI & LLMOps Implementation: Architect and deploy GenAI workflows, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, and autonomous AI agents using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or DSPy. Establish robust evaluation frameworks (Evals) for model accuracy, latency, and hallucination control.
  • Production MLOps & Orchestration: Build, deploy, and maintain robust ML training and inference pipelines using tools like MLflow, Kubeflow, Airflow, or Dagster. Ensure continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) for models and data workflows.
  • Polyglot Data Engineering: Design and audit production code across data-centric languages and frameworks (Python, SQL, Scala, Go, Rust, or TypeScript) based on speed, concurrency, and memory requirements.
  • Client Enablement & Knowledge Transfer: Elevate customer teams by establishing reusable agentic development patterns, modern MLOps practices, data reliability frameworks, and SDD methodologies so systems remain maintainable long after deployment.

Requirements

  • 10+ Years of Experience: Proven track record as a Principal Data Engineer, Lead ML Engineer, or Enterprise Data Architect building and scaling distributed data and ML platforms.
  • Customer-Facing Aptitude: Strong executive presence and communication skills to interface directly with technical teams and business stakeholders under pressure.
  • Data & ML Engineering Depth:
    • Data Infrastructure: Mastery of distributed computing (AWS Glue, Apache Spark, Databricks), modern data warehouses (Redshift, Snowflake, modeling tools (dbt), and data orchestration (Airflow, etc)
    • AI/ML & Vector Architecture: Hands-on experience fine-tuning, evaluating, and deploying LLMs, embedding models, and vector stores
    • Polyglot & Framework Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in Python and complex SQL, plus fluency in at least two other languages used in modern backend/data systems (e.g., Scala, Go, Rust, TypeScript).
  • Generative AI & SDD Experience: Demonstrated skill in using natural language and structured specs to guide AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) in generating data pipelines, schemas, and API adapters.
  • Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with cloud-native data services on AWS or Azure, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
  • Willingness to Travel: Comfort with occasional travel to customer sites as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience in a Forward Deployed Engineer, Data Architect, or technical consulting/professional services role.
  • Experience migrating legacy, on-premise data warehouses or legacy Hadoop estates to modern cloud lakehouses.
  • Deep understanding of data governance, security compliance (HIPAA, SOC2, GDPR), and privacy-preserving machine learning.

About Surfline

Millions of people around the world depend on Surfline’s products to enrich their experiences in and around the ocean. Since 1985, our company has connected people with the ocean. Starting with surfers and expanding to offshore cruisers, anglers and a myriad of other ocean enthusiasts, we’ve made it our mission to deliver peak maritime experiences. We provide those who work and play in the ocean with all the advanced tools, personalized insights and immersive content to make their lives better -- supplying them with the information they need to make smarter decisions, seek out new experiences and gain valuable knowledge.

We are dedicated to bringing people together across the globe, and we champion and encourage those who bring different perspectives, ideas, and creativity. At Surfline, we recruit, employ, train, compensate, and promote regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, and any other protected status.

Surfline's Marine business powers products trusted by boaters, offshore anglers, captains, mariners, and weather-dependent users around the world. Through brands including Buoyweather and FishTrack, we provide critical forecasting, oceanographic intelligence, and decision-making tools that help users plan, navigate, and succeed on the water.

We're seeking a Marketing Manager to lead marketing for our Marine brands as part of the Surfline Marketing team. Reporting to the Senior Director of Marketing, you'll serve as the dedicated marketing partner for the Marine business, working closely with the VP of Marine and cross-functional teams to drive awareness, engagement, subscriber growth, and long-term business success.

This is a broad, hands-on role for a marketer who enjoys wearing multiple hats. You'll develop go-to-market strategies, execute growth campaigns, support product launches, identify partnership opportunities, analyze performance, and help shape how our brands connect with customers. While you'll have access to shared marketing capabilities across Surfline - including creative, lifecycle, analytics, and content - you'll own marketing strategy and execution for the Marine business.

Under Surfline’s “Work from Anywhere” policy, this position may be performed on a full-time remote basis by candidates located in Florida.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as the dedicated marketing partner for the Marine business, aligning marketing initiatives with business priorities and growth objectives.
  • Use your expertise in the marine landscape - developing an even deeper understanding of boaters, offshore anglers, captains, mariners, and weather-dependent users to ensure every campaign, message, and initiative feels authentic and resonates with our audience.
  • Develop and execute integrated marketing plans that drive awareness, subscriber growth, engagement, and retention across Buoyweather and FishTrack.
  • Lead go-to-market strategy and execution for new product launches, features, and key initiatives, including messaging, positioning, customer communications, and promotional campaigns.
  • Plan and execute marketing campaigns across paid, owned, and earned channels, partnering with shared marketing functions including creative, lifecycle, content, and analytics.
  • Identify opportunities for partnerships, co-marketing initiatives, and community engagement that strengthen the Marine brands and expand our reach.
  • Monitor marketing and business performance, using data and customer insights to continuously test, optimize, and improve results.
  • Collaborate closely with the Marine, Product, Engineering, and Marketing teams to deliver impactful customer experiences and measurable business outcomes.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in consumer, growth, or product marketing, ideally within digital products or subscription businesses.
  • Experience developing and executing integrated marketing campaigns across multiple channels.
  • Strong understanding of customer acquisition, engagement, retention, and lifecycle marketing principles.
  • Comfortable balancing strategic planning with hands-on execution in a fast-moving environment.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience using marketing and product analytics to guide decisions.
  • Excellent project management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Self-starter who thrives with ownership and enjoys building new programs from the ground up.
  • Experience with consumer mobile apps or subscription products is preferred.
  • Passion for boating, fishing, sailing, surfing, or life on the water.

You May Also Have

  • Experience in boating, marine, weather, outdoor recreation, fishing, or adjacent enthusiast markets.
  • Familiarity with App Store Optimization (ASO), paid acquisition, CRM/lifecycle marketing, or partnership marketing.

jobs.description:
Product Designer (UX/UI + Design Systems | SaaS) – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Location: Brazil, Colombia, Argentina, Mexico
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Product Designer (UX/UI) to own the end-to-end product experience across modern web and mobile applications.

This is a product-focused design role that goes beyond creating beautiful interfaces. You’ll combine user research, product thinking, UX strategy, UI design, and scalable design systems to build intuitive, high-performing digital products that improve usability, engagement, and customer satisfaction.

Working closely with Product Managers and Engineers, you’ll transform user insights into polished, developer-ready experiences while continuously optimizing products through research, analytics, and experimentation.

If you think in user journeys, product flows, and scalable systems—not just screens—this role is for you.

Responsibilities

UX Research & Product Discovery

  • Conduct user research, interviews, usability testing, and behavioral analysis.
  • Translate research findings into personas, user journeys, workflows, and user flows.
  • Identify friction points and recommend UX improvements.
  • Leverage product analytics tools such as Mixpanel and Amplitude to inform design decisions.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers to validate assumptions and prioritize user needs.

UX/UI Design

  • Design wireframes, user flows, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity interfaces.
  • Create responsive experiences across web and mobile platforms.
  • Deliver polished, user-centered designs aligned with modern SaaS design principles.
  • Produce developer-ready assets using Figma, Adobe XD, or Sketch.
  • Iterate quickly based on stakeholder feedback and user insights.

Design Systems & Scalability

  • Build, maintain, and evolve scalable design systems and reusable component libraries.
  • Establish standards for typography, spacing, color systems, iconography, and interaction patterns.
  • Ensure consistency across products, features, and customer touchpoints.
  • Improve collaboration between design and engineering through standardized design practices.

Accessibility & User Experience

  • Design accessible experiences that align with WCAG 2.1 standards.
  • Ensure responsive usability across devices, browsers, and screen sizes.
  • Improve navigation, information architecture, and interaction design.
  • Create intuitive experiences that reduce friction and improve engagement.

Product Optimization & Experimentation

  • Conduct A/B testing on user flows, layouts, and interaction patterns.
  • Analyze user behavior and product performance metrics.
  • Optimize conversion, engagement, onboarding, and retention through iterative improvements.
  • Continuously refine designs using analytics, usability testing, and customer feedback.

Collaboration & Developer Handoff

  • Work closely with Product Managers and Engineering teams throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Deliver developer-ready specifications using Figma Dev Mode, Zeplin, or similar tools.
  • Create clear interaction documentation, design specifications, and implementation guidance.
  • Participate in sprint planning, design reviews, and product discussions.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • You think like a product designer—not just a visual designer.
  • You balance user needs, business goals, and technical constraints.
  • You enjoy solving complex product problems through thoughtful design.
  • You use research and data to guide design decisions.
  • You’re collaborative, organized, and comfortable working in Agile environments.
  • You care deeply about usability, accessibility, and scalable design systems.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in Product Design or UX/UI Design.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating:
    • UX problem-solving
    • Product thinking
    • High-quality UI execution
    • Responsive product design
  • Proficiency with:
    • Figma
    • Adobe XD
    • Sketch
  • Experience creating:
    • User flows
    • Wireframes
    • Interactive prototypes
    • Design systems
  • Strong understanding of:
    • UX principles
    • Accessibility standards
    • Usability testing
    • Responsive design
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing:
    • SaaS products
    • Consumer applications
    • Enterprise software
  • Experience building scalable design systems.
  • Basic front-end knowledge of:
    • HTML
    • CSS
    • JavaScript
  • Familiarity with:
    • Mixpanel
    • Amplitude
    • Product analytics platforms

What Success Looks Like

  • Product experiences are intuitive, engaging, and user-friendly.
  • Design systems remain scalable, consistent, and widely adopted.
  • User friction decreases while engagement and retention improve.
  • Design assets are delivered on time and developer-ready.
  • Product teams collaborate efficiently with minimal implementation issues.
  • User feedback and analytics consistently inform design improvements.

Interview Process

  • Initial Phone Screen
  • Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  • Portfolio Review & Practical Design Task
  • Client Interview
  • Offer & Background Verification

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the final step that completes your application.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This allows hiring managers to evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful while reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed. Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re passionate about designing intuitive product experiences, enjoy solving user problems through research and thoughtful design, and want to help build scalable SaaS products, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help shape digital experiences that users love.
