jobs.excerpt: Project OverviewWe are sourcing independent Vocal Audio Specialists to provide their expertise for an AI audio model training project.
jobs.description:
Project Overview

We are sourcing independent Vocal Audio Specialists to provide their expertise for an AI audio model training project. As AI models increasingly generate and interpret human musicality and vocal nuances, their accuracy relies entirely on robust, high-fidelity training data. The objective of this project is to autonomously record clean, professional-grade audio detailing human vocal pitch changes by performing consistent, highly controlled humming exercises.

Project Deliverables & Scope

Operate autonomously to generate precise audio assets and structured training data. Expected deliverables include:

  • Vocal Recording & Pitch Execution: Recording clean, pitch-stable humming takes with dynamic control (e.g., humming softly without disappearing or louder without distorting), while strictly following tonal prompts (e.g., "hum a major 3rd," "stay in key").
  • Rhythmic & Melodic Consistency: Demonstrating a solid "internal metronome" to follow beats and executing highly repeatable tasks, such as humming the exact same melody multiple times with minimal variation.
  • Audio Engineering & Quality Control: Applying professional recording competence—including proper mic proximity, gain/input controls, and gain staging—to ensure distortion-free, high-fidelity audio capture within a controlled environment.
  • Strict Instruction Adherence: Accurately executing highly specific vocal directions (e.g., "flat tone, no vibrato") to generate clean, reliable, and standardized data for model training.

Required Expertise

To successfully fulfill the deliverables of this project, Contractors must possess strong musical literacy paired with reliable home recording capabilities.

Core skillset includes:

  • Demonstrable musical literacy and performance history (e.g., choir, band, a cappella, live gigs, audio engineering, or music production) with a calm, controlled voice and a highly trained ear for pitch stability.
  • Hands-on experience in Voice Over (VO) work, studio recording, or prior AI audio training projects. (Candidates completely new to recording workflows will not meet the quality threshold for this project).
  • Strong technical recording competence, including a deep understanding of gain staging, microphone technique, and how to operate recording equipment effectively.
  • A meticulous, detail-oriented approach to following instructions and maintaining rhythmic and tonal consistency across multiple recorded takes.
  • Required Asset: Must possess a controlled, quiet home recording environment capable of capturing clean audio free from background noise, clipping, or room echo.

We offer a pay range of $6-to-$65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer, professional recording equipment, and high‑speed internet; company‑sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.

Engagement Type: Freelance / Independent Contractor

Workplace Type: Remote

Alums continue their education at Harvard University, New York University, and Princeton University, among others.

Operations Coordinator - Mission Statement

The Operations Coordinator helps power Watson Institute’s People & Operations Team, ensuring the seamless day-to-day functioning of core operational systems. This role reports to the Associate VP of Operations and supports Talent, Financial, and IT operations. This person thrives in a fast-paced, scaling environment, is highly organized, and is comfortable navigating shifting priorities and high-pressure moments with strong attention to detail and follow-through.

Talent Operations (40%)

The Operations Coordinator will support and execute key components of Watson Institute’s hiring process and talent pipeline, setting the standard for the best candidate experience across the impact space. Responsibilities include:

  • ATS Management & Candidate Coordination: Support the Operations Manager in maintaining the applicant tracking system (ATS), ensuring candidate pipelines, stages, and records are accurate, organized, and consistently up to date, while coordinating interview scheduling and supporting candidate movement through each stage of the hiring process.
  • Candidate Communication: Manage timely and professional communication with candidates throughout the hiring process, ensuring consistent updates and a positive candidate experience at every stage.
  • Onboarding Logistics: Support the Operations Manager in coordinating onboarding processes for new hires by executing key logistics, including creating and maintaining onboarding trackers within Monday.com (Work OS), coordinating schedules with internal team members and new hires, and managing system setup (e.g., email creation, platform access, and permissions) to ensure a smooth start.
  • Talent Pipeline Support: Leverage the applicant tracking system (ATS) to support the upkeep of an evergreen talent pipeline by organizing candidate records, revisiting prior applicants, and ensuring strong candidates remain accessible and easy to re-engage for future roles.

Finance Operations (30%)

The Operations Coordinator will support and execute day-to-day financial operations, ensuring accuracy and timely processing across the team. Responsibilities include:

  • Transfers & Disbursements: Execute and track financial transfers, including Fellow stipends and vendor payments, using platforms such as Wise to manage high-volume, time-sensitive domestic and international disbursements.
  • Fellowship Financial Coordination: Support Program Managers in managing Fellow stipend processes, assisting with stipend-related questions, and delivering clear, engaging presentations to Fellows on stipend processes and expectations.
  • Expense Tracking & Follow-ups: Support People & Operations expense management processes by ensuring receipts and submissions in Expensify and Airtable are complete and accurately recorded, and by following up with team members on missing or incomplete information.
  • Financial Documentation & Organization: Support financial processes by maintaining and organizing trackers within Monday.com and Google Sheets, ensuring accurate records and clear visibility across disbursements.

IT & Systems (10%)

Optimize Watson Institute’s core systems infrastructure, with a primary focus on Google Workspace Admin, ensuring systems are structured for scalability, security, and seamless team access. Responsibilities include:

  • Google Workspace: Optimize the management and organization of the Google Workspace Admin account, ensuring systems are structured to support team growth and evolving organizational needs.
  • User Set Up: Oversee user account setup, access, and permissions across platforms (e.g., Google Workspace, Slack), ensuring appropriate access and role alignment.
  • System Organization: Maintain and improve system organization, including file structures, shared drives, and internal documentation for ease of use and scalability.
  • Team Support: Serve as the primary point of contact for internal technical support, troubleshooting issues, and ensuring timely resolution.
  • Security Improvements: Proactively identify opportunities to improve security.

Supporting UFOs (20% of their time)

Support the Associate VP of Operations in executing urgent, organization-wide priorities by assisting with time-sensitive tasks, maintaining organization, and ensuring timely follow-through across key initiatives.

*New responsibilities may develop as the Operations Coordinator position evolves.

Requirements

Culture Add

In order to thrive as the Operations Coordinator at Watson Institute, a candidate must:

  • Detail Oriented: You are meticulous and have excellent organizational skills. You are especially attuned to spotting mistakes or inconsistencies in writing and external communications. You take pride in completing your work accurately and on schedule. You have a knack for project management and a love for work plans and checklists. You cringe at missed steps and you are the first to identify a typo or formatting error.
  • Intentional: Your working style is about creating order and planning ahead. You think systematically and excel at establishing elegant processes.
  • Results-Driven: You bring an eagerness to grow and to roll up your sleeves and contribute. You have a go-getter attitude and a drive to solve all sorts of problems, no matter the size or shape. When something is your responsibility, you find a way to see it through to the end.
  • High Integrity: You will be asked to make sensitive and critical judgment calls, and as such, you are known for your integrity and you take that reputation seriously. You always choose to make the right decision versus the easy decision. You know what information is sensitive, and you will protect it accordingly. You are comfortable escalating issues and holding your ground when you think it’s the right thing to do for the organization and mission.
  • Systems-minded: Demonstrated experience in building and implementing systems. You are comfortable designing, testing, improving, and smoothly running systems and processes. This could be any system that involves inputs from or serves multiple people and requires consistent and accurate functioning.
  • Communication Style: Based on a story from Watson Institute’s early days, ‘Come to the Window’ represents the principles of our communication including:
  • Obligation to Dissent: If you disagree with a decision or direction as an organization, you are expected to bring attention to this challenge because true leaders believe dissent is an obligation.
  • Disagree and Commit: To complement Obligation to Dissent, there are times when we need to Disagree and Commit. Once all concerns and criticisms are shared, the course of action must be committed to by all involved.
  • No Drama: We prioritize purpose and don’t involve ourselves in the drama created by backroom chatter, hearsay, and unnecessary focus on issues that do not place impact first.
  • Go to the Source: Our culture is defined by direct, honest, and frequent communication. We expect team members to ‘go to the source’ of concerns by speaking up, communicating frequently, and taking issues directly to the individuals involved.

Candidate Profile

Top candidates bring a strong operational mindset and are excited to build, organize, and scale systems, and should demonstrate:

  • A deep-seated passion for building and strengthening the operational infrastructure that enables Watson Institute to equip the most promising impact-driven entrepreneurs, small business owners, and leaders with the skills, networks, and resources to grow.
  • The ability to ‘weather the storm’, remaining organized, focused, and detail-oriented during fast-paced, high-volume, and time-sensitive periods, while maintaining a high standard of execution.
  • A natural inclination to build strong relationships and communicate effectively across teams, supporting collaboration and clarity in day-to-day operations.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • A systems-oriented and highly organized approach to their work.
  • Confidence navigating tech systems, with experience in tools such as Google Workspace Admin and an interest in building and maintaining scalable internal systems.
  • Eagerness to use applicant tracking systems (ATS) to improve and elevate the candidate experience, helping position Watson Institute as an industry leader in candidate experience.
  • Familiarity with or similar workflow management tools.
  • Exposure to SaaS-based tools to support operational workflows, with familiarity in expense management platforms such as Expensify preferred.
  • The ability to quickly learn and navigate new systems in a fast-paced, scaling environment.

Benefits

Salary and Benefits

  • Competitive base salary according to experience: $60,000.00-$65,000.00.
  • Annual Happiness Fund that increases with time and seniority.
  • Unlimited vacations (3 weeks required vacation time per year).
  • Healthcare benefit via Thatch (ICHRA provider), where employees have the option to apply this amount towards their choice of medical plans, with the option to add vision and dental plans.
  • Retirement account through Guideline, with an automatic 3% contribution.

The Vitals

  • The Operations Coordinator is a full-time commitment and reports to the Associate VP of Operations.
  • The Operations Coordinator can work remotely, but should be based in AZ, CO, DC, FL, GA, MD, ME, OK, PA, or SC.
  • We accept applications on a rolling basis until the position is filled.
  • We are hoping for the selected candidate to begin as soon as possible, with flexibility based on candidate availability.
  • We use E-Verify to confirm the identity and employment eligibility of all new hires.

jobs.description:
Parachute Health is transforming post-acute care as the leading digital ordering platform for medical equipment and supplies. We connect major health systems, health plans, and suppliers to help patients get the life-saving products they need at home. Since launching, we've connected 300,000+ clinicians and 3,000+ supplier locations across all 50 states and helped 15M+ patients. What started as a DME ePrescribing tool has become the order management platform of choice for home medical equipment.

Join our team and make a difference in patient care.

About the Role

Parachute Health is building the most complete and accurate catalog of home medical equipment and supplies in the industry, and that catalog is at the heart of our entire platform. Over the last few months, a consultant improved our in-house design standards, style guide, review practices, and an early set of universal merchandising attributes. We are now hiring someone in-house to take that work over and grow it for the long term.

As our Catalog Strategist & Taxonomist, you will be the expert on our taxonomy, information architecture, and catalog data model. You will serve as the catalog administrator, set and enforce catalog standards, and own catalog functionality enhancements from requirements definition and justification all the way through operational implementation. Reporting to the SVP of Merchandising Operations, you will partner closely with Operations, Product, Design, and Engineering, to make sure the catalog stays accurate, scalable, and easy to work in as we expand into new categories.

The groundwork is fairly new, so you will have a solid base to start from and real room to decide where it goes next. You get to grow the skills of an already highly-motivated Merchandising team and make the group even stronger. You will also influence R&D strategy as we build and enhance our catalog software capabilities. You will work closely with the Cat Crew R&D/engineering team, and partner with our clinical division as we launch new categories together.

This role is posted as a 90-day contract with the intent to convert to a full-time employee.

What You'll Do

  • Own the standards and structure of the global product taxonomy, category hierarchy, and catalog data model, and evolve them as we expand into new categories.
  • Maintain and evolve core catalog assets, including the global catalog style guide, training about existing and new functionality, glossary, and design review guide.
  • Serve as the catalog administrator: govern attributes, values, naming conventions, and data-quality standards across the catalog.
  • Interview category managers and subject-matter experts to learn each category's ideal state, balanced with a curiosity about current state workarounds and platform limitations.
  • Lead design reviews for category managers and analysts and provide effective feedback.
  • Up-level the merchandising team's catalog and taxonomy skills, continuing the trajectory started with the contract taxonomist.
  • Drive the standardized identification of sourcing/provenance attributes, including manufacturer, brand, and product line.
  • Set the long-term strategic direction for catalog data management, quality, and governance, and act as the senior authority the organization consults on catalog and taxonomy decisions.
  • Partner closely with R&D teams to shape near-term catalog software capabilities. Own catalog functionality enhancement requirements end to end, including definition, business justification, and the case for prioritization, then partner with the Catalog Product Manager and Engineering through development and delivery.
  • Collaborate with our clinical division to launch new categories, making sure the catalog and taxonomy support new clinical use cases.
  • Advance AI-assisted catalog tooling and workflows, such as Claude skills for catalog building and quality monitoring, and codify repeatable processes.

About You

  • Deep expertise in taxonomy, information architecture, and metadata or attribute modeling, ideally for a large, complex product catalog.
  • Hands-on experience administering catalog or product information management (PIM) systems and defining data-quality standards.
  • A track record of turning ambiguous catalog problems into clear requirements, and of justifying and prioritizing enhancement work against business impact.
  • Strong cross-functional partnership skills, and comfort being the in-house authority who sets standards and makes the final call on catalog structure.
  • Systems thinking and a bias to build durable processes, documentation, and tooling rather than one-off fixes.
  • Motivated to up-level a team that is early in building these skills, and open to direct or dotted-line management as the function matures.
  • Healthcare, DME, or medical supplies domain experience is a plus, not a requirement.
  • Knowledge of or experience in semantic web standards OWL and SKOS is a bonus.

  • Employer HSA Contribution: Company-funded contributions to your Health Savings Account

Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

Chainguard is building the most trusted source for open source software. Every artifact Chainguard distributes is evaluated by our scanner before it reaches a customer. It determines whether a package, container, or AI agent skill is safe to use—and sits between our customers and compromised software.

What began as a high-leverage internal system has become a core platform powering Chainguard Libraries, Containers, Agent Skills, and future products. We're hiring the first Product Manager dedicated to this platform.

You'll own detection quality, platform strategy, and the customer experience around scanning. You'll partner closely with Engineering and Product Security to define how organizations evaluate software trust in an AI-driven world.

Detection Quality

  • Own coverage, precision, and delivery of core product metrics.

  • Build workflows for reviewing, escalating, and correcting detections quickly.

Scanner Platform

Threat Detection

  • Partner with Product Security to identify emerging threats and publish actionable intelligence.

Customer Experience

What we're looking for:

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience with a strong track record building developer tools, infrastructure, security, or platform products.

jobs.description:
About Tailscale

Tailscale is building the new Internet by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

Join our Strategic Projects team, reporting to the team's Engineering Manager and ultimately into our co-founder and Chief Strategy Officer. This team exists to show developers and organizations why Tailscale should be their default connectivity substrate, both for internal infrastructure and for embedding into customer-facing products. Aperture, our identity-aware LLM gateway, is one such initiative.

This is an AI-native team. We use coding agents heavily as a force multiplier and expect every engineer to be a power user. Our customers demand a high bar on code quality, security, and operational rigour, and we treat that as a reason to use every tool available, including LLMs and coding agents, to ship fast without compromising it.

We move fast from idea to prototype, and we're growing the side of the team that's energized by the path from prototype to dependable product. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with product-minded engineers from the moment an idea takes shape, shaping how it's built so it holds up later, and co-owning the work of making it production-grade: stable, observable, maintainable, and ready for real customer load. You're the kind of engineer who finds the long tail of development genuinely satisfying, the edge cases, the failure modes, the tests and runbooks, the details that turn a sharp demo into something customers can rely on.

You'll work directly with reference customers on integrations and own the production bar on prototypes that graduate into Tailscale's product surface area, ensuring the security, review, and operational practices that wrap around agent-generated code actually hold in production.

Tailscale is fully remote, this team operates with significant ambiguity, and the shipping cadence is fast. Comfort working asynchronously and collaborating with highly technical customers is essential.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with product-minded engineers from the start, shaping prototypes (MCP gateways, LLM proxies, sandboxes, remote servers, and similar emerging workloads) so the path to production is built in, not bolted on.
  • Co-own the journey from "works in a demo" to "stable in production": hardening, error handling, observability, and operational tooling.
  • Own the production bar on prototypes that graduate into Tailscale's product surface area, including the security and review practices that wrap around agent-generated code.
  • Work with reference customers to integrate Tailscale, both for internal adoption (VPN replacement with identity-aware networking) and for embedding into their products, with particular attention to reliability, maintainability, and long-term supportability.
  • Find and close the long-tail gaps, edge cases, regressions, flaky behavior, missing tests, undocumented operational knowledge, that separate a prototype from a dependable product.
  • Establish and maintain the review, testing, and security practices that let the team ship agent-generated code fast without compromising the production bar.
  • Light travel required (<10%): primarily team and company onsites, with optional conferences or customer visits concentrated in North America.

What We Are Looking For

Ideal candidates will have experience taking software from prototype to production in startup-like environments. We don't expect expertise with every aspect listed below. Let us know where you feel you have the most experience and where you'd like to keep developing.

  • Strong at hardening, stabilizing, and maintaining production software; you take satisfaction in detail-oriented work and in closing the long tail of bugs, edge cases, and operational gaps.
  • Go experience is a must; comfort integrating third-party APIs; basic networking.
  • Heavy daily use of coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) and LLMs in your engineering workflow, with a point of view on where they accelerate work, where they fail, and especially how to wrap them in the review, testing, and security practices that hold the production bar.
  • Enjoy collaborating closely with exploratory, product-minded engineers and jointly owning the work of getting something solid into production.
  • Comfort with the cadence of a strategy team at an early-ish startup: priorities shift with market signal, prototype-to-production timelines are short, and the bar on what ships stays high regardless.
  • Thrive working independently in a remote environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience operating production services: observability, on-call, incident response, performance and reliability work.
  • Validating prototype code for production use alongside security teams.
  • Identity infrastructure: IdP platforms, identity sync/provisioning, directory services; authentication protocols (OAuth, OIDC, SAML, SCIM); access control models (RBAC/ABAC), session management, MFA, passwordless auth.
  • Building applications on top of LLMs and agentic systems (not just using them as dev tools).
  • Familiarity with Tailscale itself and with networking challenges in multi-cloud and hybrid deployments.
  • Open source community participation; experience producing publicly-visible artifacts (blog posts, talks, reference implementations).
  • Python, Rust, and/or TypeScript.

Why You'll Enjoy Working With Us

  • Work shoulder-to-shoulder with sharp engineers to turn promising prototypes into products customers depend on.
  • Work alongside reference customers on real integrations rather than abstract roadmaps.
  • Shape emerging AI connectivity standards and Tailscale's product strategy.
  • Collaborate with a small team of motivated, sharp, and fun engineers in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

$163,000—$226,000 USD

Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

What We Offer

  • An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.
  • A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).
  • Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!

Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.
  • Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.

About the role

At ServiceNow, we're radically transforming IT Service Management with AI by delivering on our vision of Autonomous IT—enabling organizations to move from reactive operations to intelligent, proactive, and autonomous service operations. We're now extending that vision by fundamentally changing how customers discover, adopt, and expand ServiceNow's AI capabilities through a new AI-Native Product-Led Motion.

We're looking for a Sr Staff Product Manager to define and scale this AI-Native Product-Led Motion across our AI-native ITSM portfolio. You'll own the customer journey from first AI interaction through activation, adoption, expansion, and enterprise-scale value realization. Leveraging product telemetry, behavioral analytics, AI-powered insights, and experimentation, you'll create product-led experiences that accelerate adoption, unlock new customer segments, expand our addressable market, and drive measurable growth in customer lifetime value and revenue.

This is a highly strategic role at the intersection of AI, product management, customer experience, and go-to-market strategy. Your work will directly influence how millions of IT professionals experience ServiceNow's Autonomous IT vision while building the growth engine behind the next generation of AI-native ITSM products. You'll combine AI capabilities, product telemetry, usage intelligence, experimentation, and customer-centric design to create exceptional product experiences that accelerate adoption and drive measurable business growth.

Key responsibilities

  • Define and execute the AI-Native Product-Led Motion strategy for AI-native ITSM capabilities, driving adoption, expansion, and growth across existing customers and new markets.

  • Identify opportunities to expand ServiceNow's addressable market by leveraging customer insights, usage patterns, and AI-powered experiences to unlock new segments, use cases, and markets.
  • Use experimentation and analytics to measure and improve key growth metrics including activation, adoption, conversion, retention, expansion, customer lifetime value, and revenue impact.
  • Influence product strategy and roadmap priorities through customer research, competitive insights, market analysis, and product usage data.
  • Lead cross-functional execution across Engineering, Product Management, Design, Data Science, Product Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success to deliver measurable customer and business outcomes.

Required

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to define KPIs, perform cohort analysis, evaluate funnels, and use data to drive product decisions.
  • Experience working with AI-powered products and understanding how AI capabilities create customer value and adoption challenges.

  • Experience with AI-powered personalization, recommendation systems, intelligent workflows, or usage-based expansion models.
  • Experience with enterprise SaaS platforms such as ServiceNow or competitive IT management solutions.

Why ServiceNow

ServiceNow is at an inflection point. AI is reshaping enterprise technology and redefining how organizations discover, adopt, and realize value from software. As we deliver on our Autonomous IT vision, we are building a new AI-Native Product-Led Motion that enables customers to experience the power of AI faster, more intuitively, and at greater scale.

As the Sr Staff Product Manager for AI-Native Product-Led Motion, you'll have the opportunity to define a new growth model for AI-native enterprise software. You'll design the telemetry, customer experiences, engagement strategies, and product-led mechanisms that guide millions of IT professionals from their first AI interaction to enterprise-scale adoption.

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of ITSM, combine AI innovation with customer-centric product design, expand ServiceNow's addressable market, and drive measurable impact on adoption, expansion, and revenue growth for one of the world's leading enterprise technology platforms.

jobs.description:
Couchbase, the operational data platform for AI, empowers businesses to succeed by bringing data to life in new ways. Major market-leading companies rely on Couchbase for mission critical operational, analytical, mobile and AI workloads. Built to replace legacy infrastructure and fragmented data services, Couchbase empowers enterprises with a unified platform architected for performance, flexibility and global scale.

With Couchbase, organizations bring their data to life, launching game‑changing customer experiences, exploring the limitless potential of AI, and seamlessly extending applications from the cloud to the edge and beyond. Couchbase’s AI‑ready technology and enterprise partnership model eliminate complexity and reduce total cost of ownership, enabling teams to stay agile, innovative and secure.

Couchbase believes data should never slow you down, but act as the foundation for your next breakthrough. Discover why Couchbase is trusted to help the world’s biggest players scale, move fast and stay resilient, no matter what’s next on their roadmap. Visit and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Want to be part of our story? Apply today!

About the Role

Couchbase is building the operational data platform for AI. We are hiring a Principal Product Manager, AI to own a meaningful area of the AI portfolio across Capella and Couchbase Enterprise. Reporting to the VP of AI Product Management, this Principal PM partners closely with engineering, sales and GTM, marketing, and the broader AI organization to ship capabilities that solve real problems for our enterprise ICP — at the seniority where roadmap decisions, customer commitments, and analyst positioning are decided.

This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role for someone who wants to do the work at the Principal level — write the PRFAQ, sit with the customer, push the tradeoff, ship the capability, defend the roadmap to leadership and analysts — at the center of one of the most consequential shifts in enterprise data infrastructure.

What You Will Own

  • Product strategy and execution across an AI portfolio area: End-to-end ownership of a meaningful area within the AI portfolio. Strategy in your area, the roadmap, the PRFAQs and PRDs, the launch, the adoption — and the iteration after launch. The scope is substantive enough that one or more Senior PMs may eventually contribute through the area you own.

  • Working backwards from the customer: Start with the customer and work backwards. Write the PRFAQ before any code is written. Validate with real, named enterprise customers. Make crisp tradeoff calls about what to build and what to defer based on what the enterprise ICP universally needs — not features chasing competitors or one-off requests outside the ICP.

  • Engineering partnership: Work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering. Earn their trust by being technically credible, decisive on scope, and clear on the why. Own the PRD as a living document, not a one-time artifact. Hold the bar on quality, scope, and timing through to launch.

  • Customer and design partner engagement: Run design partner programs for capabilities in your area. Bring real customer voice into roadmap decisions and back to the broader team. Build a pipeline of named reference customers willing to talk publicly about what they have shipped.

  • Cross-portfolio collaboration and build-vs-partner judgment: Coordinate across the broader product organization — Core Database, Capella, Analytics, Mobile and Edge, and the AI Specialist team — so AI capabilities compose as one platform. Apply a deliberate build-vs-partner lens: build where Couchbase is uniquely strong, and identify partnerships and integrations where we can deliver a better customer experience faster and more resource-efficiently than building ourselves.

  • Sales and GTM partnership: Equip sales, sales engineering, PMM, and partner GTM with what they need to win in the capabilities you own — positioning, demos, competitive context, customer proof points. Be the product owner in deals where the technical depth matters.

  • External voice and analyst credibility: Contribute meaningfully as the product owner in analyst engagements (Gartner, Forrester, IDC), customer briefings, keynote content, partner co-marketing, blog posts, and documentation for the capabilities you own.

  • AI-driven PM practice: Use AI deeply and visibly in your own product management work — research, PRFAQ drafting, customer synthesis, competitive analysis, roadmap modeling, engineering collaboration. Set an example for the team in what AI-driven PM and AI-DLC (AI-driven development lifecycle) practices look like in day-to-day execution.

  • PM team development: Raise the PM bar across the AI team. Mentor and coach Senior and other PMs. Contribute to interview loops, calibration, and onboarding. Help shape the operating cadence, the PRFAQ and PRD standards, and the culture.

What You Will Deliver

  • PRFAQs and PRDs for the capabilities you own, validated with named enterprise customers before engineering starts.

  • Ship capabilities within your AI portfolio area with measurable adoption and at least one named reference customer per major launch.

  • Clear, defensible tradeoff decisions visible to engineering, sales, and GTM. The team knows what is in, what is out, and why.

  • Sales and GTM enablement that the field actually uses — measured by pipeline influence and win-rate signals, not enablement-decks-produced.

  • Contributions to the broader AI portfolio narrative — analyst materials, keynote content, partner co-marketing, and blog and documentation work in partnership with the AI Specialist team, PMM, and AR.

  • Visible AI-driven PM practice that the rest of the team can learn from — concrete examples of AI-DLC in your daily work.

  • A stronger PM bar across the AI organization — through mentoring, calibration, hiring contributions, and operating cadence.

Must Have

  • Twelve or more years in product management, with at least five on a technical platform — database, data infrastructure, developer tools, or AI infrastructure.

  • Deep technical fluency in modern AI infrastructure: vector search, embeddings, RAG, agent frameworks, model serving, context engineering, and emerging interoperability standards. You can hold your own with engineering on architecture.

  • Customer obsession and working-backwards rigor: You start with the customer and work backwards. You write PRFAQs before code. You can tell which feature requests reflect universal ICP needs and which are noise, and you make the call clearly.

  • Engineering credibility: Engineers want to work with you. You hold your own on architecture, are decisive on scope, and own the why behind every tradeoff.

  • Cross-functional trust: Sales trusts your roadmap. GTM trusts your enablement. Marketing trusts your narrative. You build durable working relationships outside your own team.

  • Exemplary AI-driven PM practice: You already use AI heavily in your own PM work — research, PRFAQ drafting, customer synthesis, competitive analysis, roadmap modeling — and you can point to concrete examples. You set an example for the team in what AI-DLC looks like in day-to-day product execution.

  • Deep frontier-model experience: Advanced, hands-on experience building with frontier AI models — APIs, code-generation tools, MCP, agent frameworks, and modern developer ecosystems. Deep familiarity with Anthropic's Claude stack is strongly preferred.

  • Strong written communication. Your PRFAQs and PRDs are the artifact the team aligns on, not a chore that follows the work.

  • A shipping record — products and features you have personally taken from PRFAQ to launch to adoption, ideally including one that opened a new revenue line.

Nice to Have

  • Experience at a database, data platform, or AI infrastructure company (MongoDB, Snowflake, Databricks, Elastic, Confluent, Redis, Pinecone, AWS, GCP, Azure, or comparable).

  • Direct experience building or shipping vector search, agent memory, RAG pipelines, model serving, or related AI infrastructure capabilities.

  • Public presence — blog posts, conference talks, OSS contributions, or analyst-facing work.

  • Prior experience mentoring or developing other PMs.

Location and Reporting

Based in one of the following locations: Remote-US. Regular travel to Couchbase HQ, customer sites, partner events, and industry conferences. Reports to the VP of AI Product Management.

The anticipated starting base pay range for this role is listed below. Base salary is not the only component of our competitive total rewards package - you may also be eligible for bonus, commissions, and other benefits as described below. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, licenses and certifications, and specific work location.

Base Pay Range
$169,000—$199,000 USD

At Couchbase, we believe innovation thrives when diverse perspectives are at the table. We actively encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds—including women, people of color, LGTBQIA+ professionals, veterans, and individuals with disabilities. If you see a role that excites you, but don’t meet every qualification, we still encourage you to apply.

Studies show underrepresented talent is less likely to apply unless they meet all the criteria. We encourage you to apply if you’re excited about the role and can bring strong contributions to our team.

Why Couchbase?

Modern customer experiences need a flexible cloud database platform that can power applications spanning from cloud to edge and everything in between. Couchbase’s mission is to simplify how developers and architects develop, deploy and consume modern applications wherever they are. We have reimagined the database with our fast, flexible and affordable cloud database platform Capella, allowing organizations to quickly build applications that deliver premium experiences to their customers– all with best-in-class price performance. More than 30% of the Fortune 100 trust Couchbase to power their modern applications and build innovative new ones. See our recent awards to learn why Couchbase is a great place to work.We are honored to be a part of the Best Places to Work Award for the Bay Area and the UK. Role Description:

We're looking for a Sr. Events Coordinator to help bring our brand to life through exceptional event experiences. You’ll own the planning, coordinating, and executing of events hosted by Defense Unicorns, including customer events, hackathons, and trainings.

This role is part planner, part operator. You'll build the project plans, manage the vendors, track the budgets, and be the person on the ground making sure nothing falls apart. When something does fall apart, you fix it before anyone notices.

You'll work cross-functionally with marketing, growth, delivery, and leadership to make sure events reflect who we are and why we exist. You’ll play a key role in ensuring events run seamlessly. This is an ideal role for someone who loves organization, thrives in fast-paced environments, and enjoys balancing logistics with creative work.

Responsibilities:

The listed responsibilities are not exhaustive and additional responsibilities may be assigned based on the evolving needs of the organization. We are seeking a dynamic individual who is able to adapt and take on new responsibilities as they arise.

  • Plan and execute company-hosted events from venue sourcing through post-event wrap-up.
  • Coordinate event staffing, shipping, setup, execution, and teardown.
  • Manage vendor and venue relationships: contracts, coordination, and ongoing communication across events.
  • Create and maintain project plans, timelines, budgets, and event checklists for every event in the pipeline.
  • Track event costs, process invoices, and report expenses against approved budgets.
  • Communicate proactively about event scheduling, status updates, and changes to program directors, staff, speakers, vendors, and leadership.
  • Serve as the on-the-ground point of contact at events, handling real-time problem-solving with composure.
  • Coordinate staffing, setup, and teardown for on-site execution.
  • Manage event logistics including shipping, inventory, event materials, and vendor coordination to ensure everything arrives where it needs to be, when it needs to be there.
  • Work with marketing team members to support event promotion and ensure brand consistency across event touchpoints.

Preferred Experience and Qualifications:

  • 3–6 years of experience in corporate event planning.
  • Experience supporting government conferences, military events, or federal customers.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple events simultaneously and adapt when priorities shift mid-stream.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience working across marketing, sales, and external vendors.
  • Willingness to travel as needed for events.
  • A bias toward action: when something needs figuring out, you figure it out.
  • A genuine interest in the mission to get software to warfighters.

Nice-to-haves that'll make us especially excited:

  • Experience in the defense, national security, or gov-tech space
  • Familiarity with CRM and marketing automation platforms (such as HubSpot).

Work Style & Communication:

  • Highly organized to ensure details are addressed and deliverables are shipped
  • Comfortable shifting between heads-down planning work and high-energy event execution
  • Reliable follow-through: when you say it's handled, it's handled.
  • Direct and clear in written and verbal communication, even when delivering bad news ("the venue double-booked us" shouldn't come with a three-paragraph preamble)
  • Able to work asynchronously with a distributed team while keeping stakeholders in the loop without being asked
  • Composed under pressure: events rarely go exactly to plan, and you don't spiral when they don't
  • Receptive to feedback and willing to flag problems early rather than quietly hoping they resolve themselves

Travel Expectations: 4-10 times per year to attend events and in-person meetings

Full compensation packages are based on candidate experience. Compensation ranges are established using national benchmarking data and apply across all geographic locations within the United States.

Defense Unicorns delivers mission value by streamlining software delivery so our customers can focus on the most important challenges. We share a vision of freedom and security for the advancement of progress and innovation. Our commitment to this vision, and to our mission-driven customers, means a commitment to speed, user experience and optionality, without compromising security. Our team is composed of innovators, software engineers, and veterans with decades of experience delivering technology programs across the federal market.

We create and deliver secure solutions for continuous software integration and delivery. Performance Monitoring and Optimization:

Infopro Digital, the B2B group specialising in information and technology, is looking for a UK Senior Sales Manager to join Haynes Group Limited within its Automotive division. Haynes is an established automotive data solutions provider and is part of Infopro Digital, a global group with 4,000 employees across 26 countries.

This is not a project-sales role. Our commercial model is built around scalable SaaS and subscription solutions that create measurable, ongoing value for customers in the automotive aftermarket. We are looking for a senior sales professional who understands recurring revenue, can win and grow strategic accounts, and combines disciplined funnel management with a genuinely customer-centric approach.

WHY THIS MARKET MATTERS

The UK vehicle parc is larger and older than ever. At the end of 2025, 36.68 million cars were in use; 45.7% were more than ten years old and the average car age had risen to 9.7 years. Across the EU, passenger cars average more than 12 years old. These ageing fleets create sustained demand for maintenance, diagnostics, repair information and efficient workshop solutions - strong structural tailwinds for scalable automotive data products.

THE ROLE

Reporting to the UK Commercial Director, you will focus on winning, developing and retaining strategic UK accounts. You will manage complex opportunities from prospecting through close, build trusted customer relationships and deliver sustainable recurring-revenue growth through disciplined, value-based selling.

You will own your account portfolio and opportunity funnel - maintaining high CRM discipline, managing conversion and forecast accuracy, and progressing strategic deals while keeping customer outcomes at the centre of every conversation.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Own and grow strategic accounts

  • Own a portfolio of strategic UK accounts and prospects, with clear responsibility for new recurring revenue, retention and expansion.
  • Build robust account plans that identify customer priorities, decision-makers, commercial potential and clear pathways to growth.
  • Maintain a disciplined personal sales cadence, including prospecting, opportunity progression, account reviews and accurate forecasting.
  • Develop strong multi-level relationships across key accounts and become a trusted adviser on customer challenges and growth opportunities.
  • Work closely with the Commercial Director and internal teams to convert strategy into strong account execution.

Win new logos and expand key accounts

  • Execute a focused new-business plan across priority segments in the UK automotive aftermarket.
  • Apply a proactive hunter mindset using well-defined ideal customer profiles, account prioritisation and high-quality outreach.
  • Personally own complex and high-value opportunities from initial engagement through negotiation and close.
  • Ensure rigorous qualification and value-based discovery from first contact through solution design, commercial negotiation and close.
  • Use repeatable sales plays that can scale across customer types, use cases and territories.

Manage the funnel and sales KPIs

  • Manage your full sales funnel in CRM, ensuring high data quality, clear next steps, realistic close dates and consistent stage definitions.
  • Track leading and lagging indicators, including qualified pipeline creation, pipeline coverage, stage conversion, sales-cycle length, win rate, average contract value and new annual recurring revenue.
  • Monitor retention, renewal rate, churn, expansion revenue and net revenue retention across the installed base.
  • Use data to identify bottlenecks, improve conversion and take corrective action early.
  • Deliver accurate weekly, monthly and quarterly forecasts to the UK Commercial Director.

Grow recurring revenue through customer value

  • Sell solutions that address clear operational and commercial needs - not one-off projects.
  • Apply structured account planning, adoption reviews and value conversations across key UK customers.
  • Drive renewals, retention, cross-sell and upsell by connecting product capabilities to measurable customer outcomes.
  • Maintain strong executive relationships and coordinate the resolution of strategic customer issues.
  • Bring the voice of the customer into product, marketing and operational decision-making.

Collaborate and shape the market approach

  • Work closely with marketing on demand generation, account-based campaigns, lead quality and funnel performance.
  • Partner with product and operations to sharpen propositions, improve adoption and remove barriers to scalable growth.
  • Provide competitor intelligence, market insight and customer feedback to senior stakeholders.
  • Contribute to budgeting, territory planning, pricing discussions and the broader UK commercial strategy.

Requirements

Essential experience

  • Proven success in a senior B2B SaaS, data, information-services or subscription sales role with recurring-revenue targets.
  • Strong personal track record in new-business hunting, complex solution selling and closing strategic accounts.
  • Deep understanding of SaaS commercial mechanics and metrics, including ARR, MRR, ACV, churn, retention, NRR, CAC, pipeline coverage, conversion rates and forecast accuracy.

HOW YOU OPERATE

Hunter mentality

You create opportunities rather than waiting for them, and you know how to turn targeted activity into qualified pipeline.

Data-driven

You use facts, ratios and trends to diagnose performance and improve the system - without losing sight of the people behind the numbers.

Performance-oriented

You set a high bar for your own execution, make commitments explicit and act quickly when performance is off plan.

Customer-centric

You listen deeply, understand the customer’s business model and sell outcomes that create lasting value.

Solution-oriented

You simplify complexity, remove obstacles and bring colleagues together around practical next steps.

Scalable thinker

You favour repeatable propositions, processes and revenue streams over bespoke, one-off project work.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Consistent achievement and over-achievement of individual new ARR, revenue, retention and account-growth targets.
  • A healthy, well-qualified pipeline with sufficient coverage and improving stage conversion.
  • Reliable forecasting supported by clean CRM data and clear deal evidence.
  • A portfolio of strategic accounts with strong relationships, clear growth plans and measurable commercial progress.
  • High customer retention, stronger adoption and systematic expansion of recurring revenue.
  • Scalable, repeatable account execution aligned with the wider UK commercial strategy.

  • 2 volunteer days

  • Health cash plan

Head of Content - The Rundown

An opportunity to join an exciting, well-funded and fast-growing creator economy business.

Electrify is a dynamic new digital media company that invests in and scales creators with an established YouTube presence. We have invested in various leading channels and The Rundown is one of the leading channels in our portfolio.

The Rundown is the world’s largest AI community, informing millions of people around the world about everything going on in AI, why it matters, and how you can apply it. Our daily newsletter and social media channel engage with millions each day, and our AI University gets hands-on and educates thousands of members on using AI tools.

Come and build the future of media with us!

About the role

As Head of Content at The Rundown, you'll own the editorial bar across everything we publish — three daily newsletters (AI, Tech, Robotics), social channels, guides, newsletter takeovers, and new show formats. You'll be the manager that our team looks to, the person who ensures every piece that goes out sounds like The Rundown.

You'll also build the team that makes this possible - recruiting, hiring, and developing writers, editors, and producers as we expand from three newsletters into a multi-show, multi-format content operation. By end of year 1, we expect you'll be leading a team of 8-12+ across editorial, video, and short-form

You'll report directly to the CEO, run weekly calls, and help us scale our media ecosystem from three newsletters into a full portfolio of shows and formats.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own editorial quality across all properties: Review and edit the AI, Tech, and Robotics newsletters daily. Give direct, specific feedback to writers — not just line edits, but coaching on structure, angle, and voice.

  • Enforce brand voice consistency:Ensure social posts, guides, newsletters, takeovers, and show content all sound and look like one publication. Maintain and evolve our voice guidelines as we add formats.

  • Lead newsletter takeover editorial:Partner with the team to ensure every sponsored takeover meets our editorial standards. Push back on weak sponsor submissions and guide them toward content our audience will actually read.

  • Scale the media ecosystem:Help us go from three newsletters to a full portfolio — new shows, new formats, repeatable editorial systems, and flywheels that compound across the content ecosystem.

  • Build and lead the content team: Own the org design for editorial. Decide what roles we need next, when we need them, and what the reporting lines look like as we expand from three newsletters into shows, podcasts, and new formats.

  • Recruit and hire top editorial talent:Partner with ops to run the editorial hiring pipeline end-to-end — JDs, sourcing, screening, interviews, take-home tests, and close.

  • Develop and retain the team:Run 1:1s, give hard feedback, set performance expectations, and own onboarding.

  • Run editorial weekly calls: Lead weekly editorial syncs, track KPIs, surface bottlenecks, and bring new ideas to the CEO on where we should go next.

  • Coach and develop:Help our broader writing team level up. Give hard feedback with care. Own onboarding and recruiting for new editorial hires.

Skills and experience

  • A writer's editor:You've been a senior editor or managing editor at a publication, newsletter, or media brand. You can diagnose what's wrong with a draft in 30 seconds and articulate the fix clearly.

  • AI-native:You use AI tools daily to research, draft, fact-check, and ship faster. You can tell immediately when a piece was AI-generated and poorly edited - and you know how to fix it.

  • Obsessed with AI as a topic:You read our newsletter. You can tell the difference between genuinely important AI news and hype, and you have strong opinions about coverage.

  • Voice-calibrated: You can write in someone else's voice, teach others to do the same, and hold the line on consistency across a team.

  • A builder, not just an editor:You're excited about designing new content formats, not just polishing existing ones.

  • High trust, high ownership:You'll be the senior editorial person at a company that doesn't have one today. You thrive with autonomy and you're good at managing up.

Electrify Culture

  • Dynamic environment - We are dedicated to providing a world-class creative culture where our employees can thrive. We’re looking for self-starters with an entrepreneurial mindset who want to be part of our success story. You’ll discover new opportunities, take ownership of important initiatives and learn at a fast pace.

  • Work anywhere - We are a remote team with employees around the world. This means you are free to work from anywhere with a good internet connection.

  • Our Values – We are committed to fostering a culture that values innovative, diverse ways of thinking and the ability to drive positive change. DEI is in our DNA, and our DEI Committee and Social Hub initiatives reflect this commitment.

  • Force for good -We believe in unlocking the power of Electrify to tell stories that change lives. Digital media has the opportunity to propagate inspiring ideas and knowledge that can generate extraordinary change.Electrify Impactprovides initiatives and resources to support emerging creators and positive impact organisations amplify their voice. In support ofthe United Nations 17 sustainable development goals (SDGs), we actively encourage support on our mission to make the world a better place for all.

What we offer

  • A chance to build the sales organization behind the fastest-growing media brand in AI, reaching 2M+ professionals daily, with significantly underpriced inventory and massive headroom.

  • A global team that is passionate about the future of AI, media & education.

  • Competitive base + performance compensation, flexible hours & fully remote work.

Electrify is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We provide employment opportunities without regard to age, race, colour, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable law.

jobs.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly believe in what they are doing!

Overview

The Software Solutions Specialist serves as a technical escalation resource for Neogen software and firmware solutions, supporting internal teams in resolving complex customer issues. This role partners closely with Technical Support, Customer Success, Product, Software Development, and international teams to troubleshoot issues, document solutions, train team members, and support successful software releases.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as a Tier III escalation point for software and firmware-related customer issues, working with internal teams to troubleshoot, analyze, and resolve complex cases.
  • Support Tier I and Tier II Technical Support, Customer Success, and international teams by providing advanced troubleshooting guidance, product knowledge, and consistent support resources.
  • Learn new software and firmware functionality with each release and create or update training materials, knowledgebase content, and troubleshooting documentation.
  • Train appropriate team members on new functionality before release, including expected behaviors, troubleshooting steps, and known limitations or workarounds.
  • Monitor software bug and enhancement queues, validate reported issues, gather necessary details, and prepare accurate information before escalating to Software Development or Product teams.
  • Document steps to reproduce software or firmware issues and coordinate with Product Owners and Software Development teams to support timely investigation and resolution.
  • Recommend solutions, workarounds, or next steps for technical and product issues experienced by customers.

  • Demonstrate Neogen's values through open, honest, credible, respectful, and service-focused communication and collaboration.

Essential Requirements

  • Experience providing software support, technical support, application support, firmware support, or similar customer-facing technical troubleshooting.
  • Ability to analyze complex technical issues, identify relevant information, document findings clearly, and recommend practical solutions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to create and maintain clear knowledgebase content, troubleshooting documentation, training materials, and issue reproduction steps.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including Technical Support, Customer Success, Product, Software Development, and international colleagues.
  • Demonstrated problem-solving skills, sound judgment, attention to detail, and ability to prioritize work in a fast-paced support environment.
  • Ability to learn new software functionality, features, workflows, and tools with each release.

    • SharePoint

    • Zendesk or similar customer support platforms
    • Salesforce or similar CRM systems
    • Freshservice or similar IT service management tools
    • Confluence or similar documentation platforms
  • Education and experience in one of the following combinations:
    • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, software engineering, or a related field and 1-3 years of relevant professional software support experience; or
    • Associate degree, technical certification, or equivalent practical experience and 3-5 years of relevant professional software support experience; or
    • An equivalent combination of education, training, and experience that provides the required knowledge and skills.
  • Ability to perform the essential functions of the role, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Desirable Requirements

  • Experience supporting software or firmware products in a regulated, technical, agricultural, food safety, animal safety, life sciences, or similar environment.
  • Experience working with global or distributed teams across multiple time zones.
  • Experience validating customer-reported software defects and preparing clear bug reports for development teams.
  • Experience supporting release readiness, user acceptance testing, pre-release training, or product launch activities.
  • Familiarity with Agile development processes, product backlog workflows, defect triage, or sprint-based development.
  • Experience using data from support cases, bug queues, or customer feedback to identify trends and recommend improvements.
  • Strong customer-service orientation and ability to balance customer needs with product, technical, and business considerations.
  • Ability to move or manage limited testing equipment or hardware, typically under 40 pounds per device, as needed.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to contribute to Neogen's mission by supporting software and firmware solutions that help customers protect and enhance the world's food supply, animal health, and public health.
  • A collaborative, service-focused environment that values openness, honesty, credibility, respect, and teamwork.
  • Opportunities to work closely with cross-functional teams, including Technical Support, Customer Success, Product, Software Development, and international colleagues.
  • Exposure to new software releases, product functionality, troubleshooting methods, and continuous learning opportunities.
  • A role that may be performed remotely or in person, based on business needs, team collaboration, and role expectations.
Come Be Part Of A Mission that Matters!

From inside the farm gate to our dinner plates, Neogen protects the world’s food supply. Through a variety of animal healthcare products, to food safety solutions for dangerous bacteria, allergens, toxins, drug residues and much more, Neogen is there — and you can be too.

Mission Summary:

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Principal Engineer, Technical Lead to lead our large-scale AI model and software evaluation framework – Ground Truth Regression. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in data engineering, machine learning principals and leadership, with experience in developing and deploying advanced data analysis and large scale orchestration frameworks.

At Motional, large scale orchestration for data analysis plays a critical role in delivering our ML-centered autonomous driving vehicle. Our robo-taxi ML Models and software are developed by hundreds of developers and deployed multiple times a day – The Ground Truth Regression team provides the large scale perception analysis framework for validating all changes to perception which can impact the autonomous vehicle behavior.

The GTRegression team validates the end impact of ML and software changes to the autonomous vehicle while those changes are in development, providing the tools for Root Cause Analysis, and safety consideration. We monitor for model errors, anomalies, rare objects & long-tail driving scenarios across thousands of driving hours. The team develops the full stack – AWS Kubernetes orchestration framework, ReSimulation, model metrics, regression reports, and deep dive analysis UI’s. The team works together with all other perception and ML teams to develop the metrics and analyze results.

What You'll Do:

  • Lead a team of engineers with a diverse skill set to deliver critical software supporting the development of the autonomous vehicle ML models and software.
  • Drive innovation by researching and developing new large scale data warehousing and analysis.
  • Own large-scale data analysis workflows that surface unexpected impacts of planned and unplanned changes to the ML models and software.
  • Build high-quality datasets to improve ML products through training & edge case validation.
  • Provide statistical depth on model performance & generalization through rigorous error and change analysis.

Our team is made up of engineers, researchers, innovators, dreamers and doers, who are creating a technology with the potential to transform the way we move.

Higher purpose, greater impact.

Na pozícii Digitálny osobný bankár/bankárka bude Tvojou úlohou:

  • spravovať vlastné portfólio bonitných klientov, ktoré budeš ďalej rozvíjať;
  • aktívne kontaktovať klientov (online aj telefonicky) čo bude prirodzenou súčasťou tvojho dňa;
  • viesť online stretnutia a prinášať klientom riešenia šité na mieru;
  • identifikovať potreby klientov a premeniť ich na konkrétne obchodné príležitosti;
  • vybudovať si s klientmi pevný vzťah založený na dôvere;
  • systematicky rásť – v portfóliu, výsledkoch aj v objeme spravovaných aktív.

Toto nebude pre teba, ak:

  • potrebuješ fixný režim a stabilitu bez tlaku;
  • čakáš, že klient príde za tebou;
  • Ťa baví viac proces než výsledok;
  • potrebuješ osobný kontakt na budovanie dôvery;
  • máš pocit, že ak nevoláš, nič sa nedeje – to Ťa musí trápiť viac ako tvojho manažéra;
  • máš radšej servis ako predaj.

Ako zamestnanec/zamestnankyňa získavaš benefity, ktoré porastú tak, ako budeš rásť spolu s nami. Čím dlhšie u nás budeš pracovať, tým viac výhod získaš!

jobs.description:
True Zero Technologies, a veteran-owned small business, was founded on the principle that the purposeful enablement of people and technology in an organization directly ties to the quality of its outcomes. True Zero recognizes that those outcomes begin and end with our people, and that is what we have built a community of like-minded, driven, and passionate individuals and innovators who are aligned in a common goal of delivering top-tier services to our customers. Our culture and commitment have been recognized through numerous accolades, including being named one of the Best Places to Work in 2023 in two categories (“Prosperous and Thriving” ($5MM–$50MM in gross revenue) and “Mid-Atlantic Region” (DC, DE, MD, NC, VA, WV)), and again in 2025 as a Best Places to Work honoree. In addition, True Zero earned coveted spots on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing companies in America in 2022, 2023, and 2025, a testament to our sustained growth driven by our people-first approach and unwavering dedication to excellence.

True Zero is seeking an Information System Security Officer (ISSO) to support cybersecurity governance and Risk Management Framework (RMF) activities for enterprise information systems at the National Institutes of Health (NIH). Working under the direction of the Senior ISSO, this position partners with System Owners, engineers, cybersecurity operations personnel, and Government stakeholders to maintain the security posture and authorization readiness of assigned systems.

The ISSO is responsible for coordinating the day to day execution of RMF activities, maintaining security documentation, supporting continuous monitoring, tracking remediation efforts, and ensuring cybersecurity activities remain aligned with Federal requirements throughout the system lifecycle. This role requires strong organizational skills and the ability to coordinate activities across multiple technical disciplines while serving as a trusted advisor to system stakeholders.

Job Responsibilities

  • Support assigned information systems through all phases of the Risk Management Framework (RMF) lifecycle.
  • Maintain System Security Plans (SSPs), security documentation, and authorization artifacts to accurately reflect the operational environment.
  • Coordinate with System Owners to ensure security requirements are incorporated into system operations and lifecycle activities.
  • Collect, organize, and validate evidence supporting security control implementation and continuous monitoring activities.
  • Track vulnerabilities, POA&Ms, remediation activities, risk acceptance decisions, and corrective actions to ensure timely resolution and accurate documentation.
  • Coordinate with vulnerability management, penetration testing, and incident response teams to ensure cybersecurity findings are incorporated into authorization documentation and continuous monitoring activities.
  • Support annual assessments, Security Control Assessments (SCAs), audits, and authorization reviews by coordinating evidence collection, documentation updates, and stakeholder participation.
  • Monitor system changes to identify potential impacts to authorization status and coordinate required documentation updates.
  • Assist with contingency planning, incident response planning, interconnection security agreements, privacy documentation, and other required cybersecurity artifacts.
  • Prepare recurring authorization status reports, remediation updates, and security summaries for Government stakeholders.
  • Participate in change management, configuration management, governance meetings, and continuous monitoring activities to ensure cybersecurity considerations remain integrated into operational decision making.
  • Coordinate closely with engineering teams to ensure security controls are properly implemented and documented.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen authorization quality, improve documentation accuracy, and enhance operational efficiency.

Job Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
  • Three or more years of experience supporting Federal cybersecurity, RMF, Assessment and Authorization (A&A), or information assurance programs.
  • Working knowledge of NIST SP 800-37, NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5, FISMA, and Federal cybersecurity requirements.
  • Experience supporting authorization package development and maintenance.
  • Experience coordinating with System Owners, engineers, cybersecurity operations teams, and Government stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and technical writing skills.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to coordinate activities across multiple organizations.

    • Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting NIH, HHS, or other Federal civilian agencies.
  • Experience using JCAM, eMASS, ServiceNow GRC, Archer, or similar governance platforms.
  • Experience supporting continuous monitoring, vulnerability management, POA&M management, and cybersecurity assessments.
  • Familiarity with cloud environments, Zero Trust initiatives, and enterprise security operations.
  • Experience supporting FISMA reporting, audit preparation, and ongoing authorization programs.

    • Preferred Certifications:

    One or more of the following is preferred:

    • Security+
    • Certified in Governance, Risk and Compliance (CGRC)
    • CAP (Certified Authorization Professional)
    • CISSP
    • CISM
We’re actively searching for talented security and technology practitioners who are ready to experience the True Zero difference. As a True Zero team member, you'll enjoy:
- Competitive salary, paid twice per month
- Best in class medical coverage
- 100% of medical premiums covered by True Zero
- Company wide new business incentive programs
- Contribution Incentives (i.e. white papers, blog posts, internal webinars, etc.)
- 3 weeks of PTO starting + 11 Paid Holidays Annually
- 401k Program with 100% company match on the first 4%
- Monthly reimbursement of Cell Phone and Home Internet costs
- Paternity/Maternity Leave
- Investment in training and certifications to broaden and deepen your technical skills

We are actively seeking a GVP, Global Product Development. The role will be based in the US and may work from a remote office. The role will report directly to the EVP & Chief Delivery Officer of Rimini Street.

This leader will be responsible for building a scalable global product development model that supports Rimini Street's enterprise software services portfolio, improves speed and quality of delivery, strengthens product and regulatory execution, and drives operational excellence through modern development practices, automation, Agile/DevOps discipline, and cross-functional collaboration

  • Build, develop, and mentor a high-performing leadership team while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, quality, and operational excellence.
  • Represent Product Development in executive, client, partner, and strategic stakeholder engagements as required.
  • Drive long-term organizational capability, succession planning, and talent development to support future business growth.
